name: Ruben Gallego
subject: a dark day
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.
#

Peter, I am incredibly disappointed.
Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.
They are enforcing a near-total ban on abortion that was originally passed before Arizona was even a state, in 1864, during the Civil War.
No exceptions for rape. No exceptions for incest.
As a father, I am fearful for my daughter. As an Arizonan, I am fearful for the people of my state. And as an American, I am absolutely furious that this has come to pass.
It’s not lost on me that this happened because of the Supreme Court that Donald Trump built, and because the Senate failed to act to protect abortion rights when they had the chance.
It’s a dark day, but this is **NOT** over.
If I make it to the Senate I will do everything I can to pass legislation that will make the protections provided by _Roe v. Wade_ the law of the land — including reforming the filibuster if that’s what it takes.
I’m a Marine, and I’ll fight alone if I have to. But we’ll accomplish a lot more together. So please, if you’re looking for a way to channel your anger into action, consider supporting my campaign.

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: a dark day
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Debbie for Florida
body:
Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born
| | |
---
Team, I am incredibly disappointed.
Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.
They are enforcing a near-total ban on abortion that was originally passed before Arizona was even a state, in 1864, during the Civil War.
No exceptions for rape. No exceptions for incest.
As a father, I am fearful for my daughter. As an Arizonan, I am fearful for the people of my state. And as an American, I am absolutely furious that this has come to pass.
It’s not lost on me that this happened because of the Supreme Court that Donald Trump built, and because the Senate failed to act to protect abortion rights when they had the chance.
It’s a dark day, but this is **NOT** over.
If I make it to the Senate, I will do everything I can to pass legislation that will make the protections provided by _Roe v. Wade_ the law of the land — including reforming the filibuster.
I’m a Marine, and I’ll fight alone if I have to. But we’ll accomplish a lot more together. So please, if you’re looking for a way to channel your anger into action, consider supporting my campaign.

Thank you for your interest in Hogan For Maryland! From Opening Day to kicking off our 10-day [**Back to Work Bus Tour**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=0be6f316f0&e=3ef74f1f93) , we have had a busy few weeks out on the campaign trail.
If you’d like to join us on our travels across the state or get involved with the campaign, [**be sure to sign up today!**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=c0398204bb&e=3ef74f1f93)
**Looking Ahead:** Voting for the May 14th primary is already starting and mail-in ballots are being distributed across the state.
Spread the word to your family and friends, and cast your vote for Governor Hogan today by going to [**larryhogan.com/vote**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=44c9568d48&e=3ef74f1f93) and requesting your absentee ballot!
**Mark Your Calendar:** Hogan for Maryland is hosting a Back to Work Barbeque on Saturday, May 4th—and you’re invited! For more information, click [**here**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=4a757d72e8&e=3ef74f1f93).
**ON THE ROAD: WHERE WE’VE BEEN**
**Thursday, March 28:** Baseball is back! To celebrate the Orioles Opening Day, Governor Hogan made multiple stops in Baltimore City—including [Gameday Firehouse](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=44d1552626&e=3ef74f1f93) and [Pickles Pub](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=61729e6031&e=3ef74f1f93)—prior to attending the game at Camden Yards, where he grabbed a bite to eat at [Boog’s BBQ](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=035dd43bb3&e=3ef74f1f93).
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=93868c0fd5&e=3ef74f1f93)
[Watch Governor Hogan’s video from Opening Day.](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=4d521e0d0b&e=3ef74f1f93)
**Monday, April 1:** Following the Easter weekend, Governor Hogan started his week by [meeting with leaders](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=ec47e6ec17&e=3ef74f1f93) from the International Longshoremen Association to discuss critical needs and priorities following the collapse of the Key Bridge.
**Wednesday, April 3:** Governor Hogan traveled back to Baltimore City to visit local businesses and community centers, including [Lexington Market](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=2283901158&e=3ef74f1f93), [Hardware Plus](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=4d5ef9b5bd&e=3ef74f1f93), and the [EMAGE Center](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=caf8f5c39f&e=3ef74f1f93) with Lieutenant Governor Boyd Rutherford.
| | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
**Thursday, April 4:** Governor Hogan and our team [traveled out to Garrett County](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=85ad2ad1ed&e=3ef74f1f93) on Thursday afternoon, and grabbed dinner at [Mountain State Brewing Company](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=0cb592558f&e=3ef74f1f93) in McHenry.
**Friday, April 5:** Governor Hogan kicked off his 10-day [Back To Work Bus Tour](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=0c034066cb&e=3ef74f1f93) in Western Maryland where he made eleven stops across Garrett, Allegany, and Washington Counties. During his time in Western Maryland, Governor Hogan spoke to several local leaders, small business owners, and first responders across the region.
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=41289fe1a9&e=3ef74f1f93)
[Watch video of Governor Hogan’s stops in Western Maryland.](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=6f4c57f239&e=3ef74f1f93)

**Saturday, April 6 and Sunday, April 7:** Governor Hogan spent the weekend connecting with hundreds of voters in Washington, Frederick, Carroll, and Baltimore Counties as part of the Back To Work Bus Tour.
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=6db45e5406&e=3ef74f1f93)
[Watch video of Governor Hogan’s stops on Saturday.](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=fa772caa9f&e=3ef74f1f93)[Watch video of Governor Hogan’s stops on Sunday.

](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=bbfed2b776&e=3ef74f1f93)**Monday, April 8:** Governor Hogan [met with small business owners](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=260a891a23&e=3ef74f1f93) at Twin Valley Distillery in Montgomery County.
Through Monday afternoon, Governor Hogan and our Hogan for Maryland Team have **made over 30 stops across 7 counties** —with many more to come this week.
To keep up with all of Hogan for Maryland’s [**Back to Work Bus Tour**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=728baf0652&e=3ef74f1f93) stops each day, follow along on Governor Hogan’s [Facebook](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=eefdb05029&e=3ef74f1f93), [Twitter](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=f17fffb78b&e=3ef74f1f93), and [Instagram](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=9782d56005&e=3ef74f1f93).
**WORD ON THE STREET (AND ON THE RADIO)**
In Western Maryland, Governor Hogan joined [News Talk 103.7FM](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=ae66b9e074&e=3ef74f1f93) with Patrick Ryan to discuss the main concerns he hears from voters across the state: _**“People are concerned about the same things they’re concerned about in the rest of the country ... . I talk to people every day who have never been more concerned about the direction of the country and they’re really kind of fed up and frustrated with politics as usual in Washington.”**_
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=d7e115bd50&e=3ef74f1f93)
Governor Hogan continues to speak out against the irresponsible tax increases the Maryland General Assembly is imposing on Marylanders: _“**The old tax-and-spend ways of Annapolis have returned in full force with the decision by Maryland leaders to push through hundreds of millions of dollars in new taxes. With inflation out of control and families struggling to pay their bills, it’s the absolute last thing people need right now.”**_
Read his full statement [here](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=779d7a6ae4&e=3ef74f1f93).
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=693dcc264b&e=3ef74f1f93)
In case you missed it, Governor Hogan sat down with Jewish Insider while attending the [JCC’s Community Block Party](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=fdea03b777&e=3ef74f1f93) to reaffirm his support for Israel and Maryland’s Jewish Community: _**“I’m concerned about the rise in antisemitism ... I’m gonna continue to stand firm, it’s where I’ve always been.”**_
Read the full article in Jewish Insider [here](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=28c674e521&e=3ef74f1f93).
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=10779ab3b5&e=3ef74f1f93)
If you’d like to join us on our next adventure, [be sure to sign up to get involved with the campaign today!](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=d5b505e7d5&e=3ef74f1f93)
Let’s get back to work!
Rob**Team Hogan**

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 4/9/2024
body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
Heidi Ganahl introduces the Rocky Mountain Voice, a new conservative news media platform for Coloradans to be the VOICE of your VALUES.
| |
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| Hello, More than a dozen states from Texas to Maine were in the path of a total solar eclipse yesterday. Check out the photo towards the bottom of the newsletter to see how it appeared to a Rocky Mountain Voice reader near Whitney, Texas. This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, April 9, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
# TODAY'S TOP STORIES
---
[**Editorial: Trump abortion policy a turn toward state’s rights**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [BY ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)RMV EDITORIAL BOARD, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
| [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**The issue:** President Donald Trump this week announced his abortion policy, favoring states independently deciding how to regulate abortion. **We say:** Regardless of your position on abortion, this view respects the concept of state’s rights written into the 10th Amendment to the U.S. Constitution by the Founding Fathers, and is a respectful position for freedom and liberty. The Founding Fathers of a young nation they called the United States of America never had the intention for an over-intrusive federal government to create a nanny state, where our every action is regulated and legislated. We were to be an independent, free people; a republic, if we could keep it. In the 10th Amendment to the U.S. Constitution, the final entry into the Bill of Rights, the Founders wrote: “The powers not delegated to the United States by the Constitution, nor prohibited by it to the States, are reserved to the States respectively, or to the people.” **[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

[**Get ready for $5-a-gallon gasoline as result of gains in crude oil pricing**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[THE STREET](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Gasoline prices may surge to [$5 per gallon due to a 20% increase in crude oil prices](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) this year, driven by various factors including Middle East tensions, global supply disruptions, OPEC production cuts, and increased demand.

* Energy stocks have been performing strongly, with companies like Exxon Mobil, Chevron, and ConocoPhillips [experiencing significant gains](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

* There are concerns that closing the Strait of Hormuz could lead to a $40 jump in crude oil prices, potentially causing a recession. Analysts predict crude oil prices could [surpass $100 a barrel by fall](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), with some estimating even higher prices.

* Current national average gasoline prices are around $3.59 per gallon, with some regions already exceeding $5 per gallon, such as in California's Mono County where prices reach [$6.05 per gallon](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**‘How much are we spending on it?’: Denver auditor reviewing costs of city’s homeless shelters**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[WESTWORD](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Denver Auditor's Office is conducting [an audit of the city's shelter system](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and expenditures on housing the homeless, aiming to conclude by late July or early August.

* Concerns arose during a Denver City Council committee meeting about [discrepancies between approved expenditures and actual spending](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), prompting questions about where the allocated funds are going.

* The audit, initiated in late 2023, is currently in the [scoping process](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to determine the focus areas and potential risks within the shelter system. Previous audits have highlighted gaps in tracking expenses related to homeless services and encampment efforts, signaling the need for improved monitoring and oversight.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**Poll finds illegal immigration top issue for Colorado voters**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* A statewide poll conducted by the Colorado Polling Institute reveals illegal [immigration as the top concern for Colorado voters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), with approximately two-thirds viewing it as a significant problem.

* [Homelessness](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) ranks as the second most important issue, reflecting longstanding concerns in Denver.

* While respondents prioritize illegal immigration, they differ on assigning blame, with most [faulting Congress for inaction](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) on proposed border legislation and citing various actors such as the Biden administration, Denver's immigrant policies, and Texas Governor Greg Abbott.

* The [poll](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), conducted from March 15 to 19, also addressed topics such as sports betting legalization, wolf reintroduction, and the Taxpayer Bill of Rights (TABOR), aiming to inform public discourse and decision-making in the state.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**COMMENTARY: Without mutual civic trust, there would have been no American Founding**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
THOMAS L. KRANNAWITTER, PH.D., [LIBERTY LYCEUM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _The Signers of the Declaration of Independence concluded with a famous and solemn pledge—their lives, fortunes, and sacred honor. This was no small matter. What they were calling “revolution” was, from the British point of view, treason against the Crown and punishable by death. Yet, the Signers stood strong and launched the greatest experiment in freedom the world has witnessed, a movement held together by a powerful kind of social and political glue: Trust._

_The pledge offered by the Signers in the Summer of 1776 was not a promise to God, nor to fellow citizens. The pledge they made was to each other. They knew, every one of them, that if some broke the trust when the going got tough—and the going was about to get very tough!—others would likely break it too, and the revolution would fail. Betraying their mutual trust would likely mean that each would die in vain and freedom would have to wait for another time and place. But they honored their trust, at great cost in blood, money, and suffering._ [**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️** **[Mesa County’s Scott Thompson named Surveyor of the Year](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY RMV STAFF | MESA COUNTY | APRIL 8** _Scott Thompson, elected in 2019 as Mesa County’s surveyor and re-elected in 2023, has been named this year’s “Surveyor of the Year” by the Professional Land Surveyors of Colorado._ **[Florida Rep. Matt Gaetz calls on Colorado Republicans to ‘stand with President Trump’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | APRIL 7** _Don’t let it be said Florida Congressman Matt Gaetz can’t read a room.__As he stepped to the stage to deliver a keynote address to Colorado Republicans here Saturday, he could have stopped after his first few words.__“This is Donald Trump’s party, and I am a Donald Trump Republican,” Gaetz started._ [**Greg Lopez calls for Republican unity as path to turn Colorado red**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | APRIL 6** _The high stakes of potentially losing the slimmest of margins in the U.S. House of Representatives could be in play if the Colorado Republican Party does not unify, Greg Lopez told delegates today as he addressed the party’s assembly here._ [**Boebert wins 4th District assembly, qualifies for place on Republican primary ballot**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | APRIL 5** _A week that began with an unexpected surgery ended with a pleasant result for Lauren Boebert.__“I didn’t care if I had to come here on a stretcher,” she said. “I was going to honor the delegates and this valued process in Colorado.”_ _Boebert collected 40.8% of delegates here Friday in the 4th District Assembly and earned a spot on the Republican Party’s primary ballot for the U.S. House._ **Feel like you have a unique story or commentary to share?** We'd love to talk with you about becoming an RMV Contributor. Reply to this email (or reach out to [brian](mailto:brian@rockymountainvoice.com)[@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:brian@rockymountainvoice.com)) or send us a message on social media to chat!
# 🤔 DID YOU KNOW?

On April 9, 1859, the **first silver discovery** occurred in Colorado at Gold Hill in Boulder County. This discovery marked the beginning of Colorado's silver boom.

subject: Re: Shop green this Earth Day
body:
__Knowledge is power. Pass it on - and build a safe and just tomorrow. |
---

| If you're still on the hunt for how to make a difference this Earth Day, look no further!

Join the movement for a greener future and head over to the LCV Shop for products that spotlight protecting people and the planet in every fiber. Every step matters in the path toward environmental progress, and it's never too late to shop sustainably with future generations in mind. [Because our Earth is worth fighting for, no matter how you do it.](https://links.messages.lcv.) |

* * *

---

** **
|
There are many ways to celebrate Earth Day, and here at the LCV Shop, we want to make it easier for every day to be Earth Day. Using eco-friendly products and shopping sustainably is something anyone can take part in.

It's no secret that eco-friendly products can offer a way to reduce, reuse, and recycle that considers the life cycle of products from purchase to disposal. LCV Shop products display messages on vital environmental issues such as clean water, national parks, and democracy, but there's even more than meets the eye. Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zhgdgsflar1onjbbf8s8pmkosjp9mg7jttst016g_rp22sh2s8i6ep32ctgm8ob6c9h2bs)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z0du9725ol7avjcbortfr5gbl8t8cgtbvj1bogfg_rp22sh2s8i6ep32ctgmao34c9h2bs) That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zhosckj9bgal8b6keuvv6dmp0ovpq01s23i6g7so_rp22sh2s8i6ep32ctgmao34c9h2bs)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: can you help them?
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

These wonderful canvassers are never going to be the focal point of the media’s story.

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-suikijl-duchtdja-y/) But if the pro-life movement manages to STOP the Abortion Lobby and their pet politicians this November, our canvassers’ work – **_all made possible by the generosity of good folks like you_ – will be a BIG PART of the reason why.**

Frankly, we push our Pro-Life Canvassers to the max trying to knock on as many doors as possible in key districts across the country.

They travel non-stop across states canvassing, engaging with voters, having conversations, leading text messaging, phone banks, and media campaigns, and registering pro-life voters . . .

They have bruised knuckles from knocking on doors, blisters from walking neighborhoods, and stories of being accosted by angry pro-abortion radicals they’ve run into.

But these courageous young women and men don’t mind.

They realize how important 2024 is.

They know their efforts today through November will result in more precious lives being saved from the violence of abortion.

**[Pro-Life Friend, will you please prayerfully consider sending a PRO-LIFE CARE PACKAGE to one of our student canvassers to encourage them as the battle for Life heats up in 2024](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-suikijl-duchtdja-j/)?**

Our team of Pro-Life Canvassers are the backbone of our 2024 efforts.

It would be a lot easier if we just ran broadcast TV ads like all the high-paid political consultants say you “have to do.”

**But the truth is, we know the best way to change hearts and minds – and convert Pro-Life First voters is with one-on-one conversations.**

Not only are these conversations critical to converting voters and driving pro-life turnout in November, but they’re also shifting the larger cultural battle – one we cannot ignore if we want to make abortion illegal and unthinkable.

Thankfully, _Students for Life Action_ is hard at work with several canvasser deployments already scheduled across the country!

We just wrapped up successful door knocking in Indiana and South Carolina, but we’ll also be in key battleground districts in:

**●** West Virginia **●** Florida **●** Kentucky **●** Arizona **●** Pennsylvania **●** Kansas **●** And many more states in the lead up to November!
It’s so crucial that we support our volunteer canvassers the best we can.

These young men and women are on the front lines every day putting in late nights of driving or making calls, having doors slammed in their faces, and even being harassed and attacked by pro-abortion radicals.

And they do it willingly! All to find the voters who are receptive to our message.

**[So, your contribution of even $25 for a hot pizza that our canvassers can enjoy after a long day, would be greatly appreciated](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-suikijl-duchtdja-i/).**

But what I’d really like to do is send them a whole care package to keep them going.

Something that says, _“Thanks for all your hard work, and God bless you!”_

A **[Care Package Gift of $100](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-suikijl-duchtdja-d/)** can provide the door-knocking materials they need like _Students for Life Action_ shirts, flyers, postcards, markers, and more!

And a **[Care Package Gift of $50](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-suikijl-duchtdja-h/)** can pay for a tank of gas for a canvasser’s day of driving to and from strategic locations.

But, if you’d be willing to provide one canvasser with all the materials, gas, and meals they’ll need while they volunteer for us – _a whole care package_ – **[a generous Care Package Gift of $250 would accomplish that](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-suikijl-duchtdja-k/).**

It’s clear the Abortion Lobby thinks they already have 2024 in the bag.

And they certainly don’t hide the fact that it’s the tainted millions they make from their bloody “business” that makes them so certain – _not to mention the $600+ million in tax-payer funding they rake in every year._

When you look at the financial numbers, this certainly is a David vs. Goliath battle.

But you and I both know how that story ended.

I have a secret weapon that has **_PROVEN_** to defeat the Abortion Lobby time and again – and I want to share our secret weapon with you . . .

It’s you, Pro-Life Friend.

It’s you and countless other pro-lifers – _like our dedicated canvassers_ – who, through their time, talent, and treasure, help _Students for Life Action_ continue to exceed the Abortion Lobby in support!

Just look at what we did with _Roe v. Wade._

It’s sitting on the ash heap of history now.

And we couldn’t have done it without the decades of hard work from our volunteers – all of whom are supported by the generosity of good folks like you.

**[So, please consider making your most generous Care Package Gift of $250, $100, $50, or even $25 to _Students for Life Action_ right away](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-suikijl-duchtdja-u/).**

Thank you for everything you do for Life!

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

P.S. – _Students for Life Action_ has been on the front lines waging a battle to protect the sanctity of Life.

Thanks to the efforts of pur Pro-Life Canvassers in key districts nationwide, we’re able to convert pro-abortion voters to the Pro-Life Movement just by knocking on their door!

**[Will you consider sending a canvasser, like the ones pictured above, a Care Package Gift to encourage them to keep fighting](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-suikijl-duchtdja-o/)?**

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

| MANAKIN SABOT, VA -- 100% Pro-Trump 5th Congressional District candidate, former Navy SEAL, Virginia Senator, and business owner John McGuire today announced that he has been endorsed by former Bedford County Sheriff Mike Brown.
Brown has served in law enforcement for five decades and is a fellow veteran who served in the U.S. Army.
---
| 24 Year Bedford County Sheriff Endorses McGuire for Congress
---
| | |
---|---
|
"Today I am officially endorsing John McGuire to be our next Congressman for the 5th District of Virginia. John's experience as a Navy SEAL, work ethic, and his demonstrated success in the Virginia General Assembly at bringing people together for the good of our community is exactly what we need in Virginia. Please join me in voting for John McGuire in the June 18 Primary."

\- Sheriff Michael J. Brown, Ret.
President, Emeritus
Small, Rural & Tribal Law Enforcement Executives Association

Paid for and Authorized by McGuire for Virginia
| McGuire said: "Residents of Bedford County say Sheriff Mike Brown was beloved by everyone. He is one of the most impactful sheriffs in the Commonwealth in the past 50 years. His vision of creating one of the first Internet Crimes Against Children Task Forces in 1998 resulted in rescuing thousands of children across the globe. I am truly honored to have his 51 years of military, law enforcement and civic engagement to helping our team. My plan in Congress is to support all efforts to protect children."
We need leaders who grow our party rather than shrink our party. McGuire is running against Never Trumper Bob Good in the VA-05 primary. McGuire has been seeing significant momentum during the race, including out raising Good during the most recent fundraising quarter.

name: Hillsdale College via Restore Our Nation
subject: The key to Lincoln's rhetorical success
body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SvkbuwPfmzHqs30qBV9FVg~~/AARclAA~/RgRn-)
---
| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** **** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.
---
| [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SvkbuwPfmzHqs30qBV9FVg~~/AARclAA~/RgRn-)
---
| | That’s why we need the support of friends like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.
Quantities of this special DVD box set are limited, so reserve your copy today. I’ve included a secure link for you to make your tax-deductible gift below:
[_**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/dvd-mathematics-and-logic-course**_](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SvkbuwPfmzHqs30qBV9FVg~~/AARclAA~/RgRn-)
Thank you for partnering with Hillsdale in its mission on behalf of liberty.
Warm regards,
Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

## Seven More States Sue Over Student Loans
Seven states, led by Missouri, [filed a federal lawsuit Tuesday](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDtu6zAQAE8jdTT4WVJSweI17vzalAI_S3kDmjSkjYzcPnDqlINpBvNxW2-BKrXtf3ig59LXkJhOXEEoKTSsMGZfEDWaEb2alJ6sUwuMd5_cFIKxTuYo0xyXkMFFDZhQuVxKHslrqUGCknKxDsxlclHOyc5qtrMrKQ0gMRP3_fLZqfEdS_3uJ-6X1B9j9Xfm5zGYf4O-Dvoang1fx1u9YWdKFQd9PfgrY2ORMbJIoSWsNTD1JlKvFTcUpe8bndjwOERZIC6TdDGbxUajESBDVtEUV4q0atx9fr6oVjrcNIDcHoHqbw7_OecnAAD__7j_ZjY) to block President Biden's February "SAVE" Plan for forgiving student debt, joining 11 other states that filed suit last month. Tuesday's lawsuit targets an earlier effort by the White House to cut student debt after the Supreme Court ruled that any forgiveness plan needed congressional authorization. Instead, the SAVE plan was billed as a "student loan safety net" that canceled some student debts. The 18 total states involved in the current lawsuit are all Republican-led states. Missouri's attorney general argued that Biden's ["SAVE" plan is illegal](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFugzAURb_GbA_ZxmAyMDSDt7RjR2Twc3BjbIQfQf37Kpk73Sud5eh838abDTGk-6ddcSCfRztTeOKoQHCQalSVGzyixKbCQWghdduJi6qWwblW8aYT3iM2WmilLaK4eI5c9nISVRgkl4orwfml7VRT627i_dz2om_7zs8zUxxdoLzXPzkkWtDH3_zEvZ7zWsVhIdoKaz6YNEya8zzrtaQXY9JggqMwaRKer3l_DWveEQpZwgLlQKAMU8zzA6bgMBUodDhMBDHbBItNLh8EW7QJbIFoz3IEKrCFiHBsTBq7w_Uq4sN8mWof3HaGGEPpNFP8vtoQ36L0b7a_AAAA___dE2-U) and would cost U.S. taxpayers $475 billion.

On December 3, 2019, the Kansas City Police Department observed a red pick-up truck chasing another vehicle through the city streets. The chopper tracked the car to the backyard of a home - and Detective Eric DeValkenaere and his partner were the first to arrive at the scene. Eric approached the passenger side of the pick-up and his partner approached the driver's side, both shouting commands at the driver to STOP and SHOW HIS HANDS. Eric saw the suspect reach toward his waistband and grab a handgun, pointing it directly at his partner. Fearing the suspect would shoot, Eric discharged his firearm four times into the windshield of the pick-up as it continued driving into the garage. When officers entered the garage, they found the suspect deceased with his arm hanging out of the window and his .45 semi-automatic pistol on the ground. (A weapon they would later learn was stolen.) No doubt Eric saved his partner's life that afternoon - and probably his own. **But instead of receiving an award for his heroic actions, Eric DeValkenaere was charged with Involuntary Manslaughter and Armed Criminal Action by a District Attorney desperately trying to hold onto her elected seat on the bench.** Worse, the Missouri Supreme Court just declined to take Eric's case - exhausting his options through the justice system. _Even though the Missouri Attorney General agreed Eric is innocent, woke anti-cop prosecutors and the defund the police mob somehow still won!_ **A pardon from Missouri Governor Mike Parson is one of Eric 's last remaining options for freedom.** **[Now you know why I'm asking you to follow this link to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition right away.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=22f9791b70814ab9b055940cc63ac942&_e=dQFPx-3Of89WlGWu2HtcqUKJpB-ZXm1WFsPc1NJQVjxdLJh3ai5V0nWRffqTLR7pAkXCwogtiXfG1CW65en7YWglj4XXpbOofRDKemwaAaMpSYIc5rOJeBlQY1TGJcqKBMHBKMMCLO9jOi9PS4Ug3Ee934Yv_MjqUysOn1VB2mrx_MBYvGO-lDOedDYdweQt27jBQYvc3ISgDuOSGz7za0QIsc56tHFVmhefrZtIj461lMr9757_D8iM51uNTjyp2a5eMc8FNyQ-c8ZZvweoeJ11vlf0J_qtsVlZcHvawnnManMFCfmIbeG9xPr-G5JkPH8Tl8Hv84qq3hbw4jzOx9vzMqGuKibaVGgUVaaPsgZlHqWqf85uYMUKIXLjMnRl)** My name is Stephanie Mohr and I'm proud to be on the Board of Directors for the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund - a non-profit organization that supports and defends wrongly accused officers like Eric. Over the last few years, LELDF has helped many men and women in blue clear their names and win back their freedom. I am also one of those officers LELDF has helped. You see, I used to be a police officer with the Prince George's County Police Department in Maryland. Then one night I was called to a burglary scene. I did everything by the book - including releasing my canine to apprehend the suspect. We arrested the suspect, an illegal immigrant who was convicted and deported. | | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight."
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That's why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **" Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry." **
Through** "Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,"** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---

Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...

body:
Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.

| | | | | Peter, I am incredibly disappointed. Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born. They are enforcing a near-total ban on abortion that was originally passed before Arizona was even a state, in 1864, during the Civil War. No exceptions for rape. No exceptions for incest. As a father, I am fearful for my daughter. As an Arizonan, I am fearful for the people of my state. And as an American, I am absolutely furious that this has come to pass. It’s not lost on me that this happened because of the Supreme Court that Donald Trump built, and because the Senate failed to act to protect abortion rights when they had the chance. It’s a dark day, but this is **NOT** over. If I make it to the Senate I will do everything I can to pass legislation that will make the protections provided by _Roe v. Wade_ the law of the land — including reforming the filibuster. I’m a Marine, and I’ll fight alone if I have to. But we’ll accomplish a lot more together. So please, if you’re looking for a way to channel your anger into action, consider supporting my campaign. [**Split a donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action today and we will direct every dollar you send to us towards defeating Kari Lake and Donald Trump in Arizona. body:
Your number is being called today, Friend.

---
**I put a bullet through Osama bin Laden's skull, Friend. **

It's Rob O'Neill. I'm a Navy SEAL. At my core, I am built to serve this country; I will do _**WHATEVER**_ it takes to make America safe and prosperous.

I hope you share that sentiment. And if you don't, then the rest of this message just isn't for you. Feel free to delete this email and move on with your life if you're not committed to American excellence.

**If you 're still reading, then I thank you for your commitment. And now, I'm counting on you to rise to the occasion, Friend. **

My Navy SEAL brother, Senior Chief Derrick Van Orden, needs your help. He served our nation for over 25 years in the Navy and fought extremists from the Taliban to Al-Qaeda. Upcoming Events: Join Us for a Memorable Experience!
[West Des Moines, Iowa](https://www.kennedy24.com/west-des-moines-assembly?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=weekly_news_4_10_24_rs_a4&n=2) \- Saturday, April 13th at 2:00 PM
Are you ready to make history? Join U.S. Presidential Candidate Robert F. Kennedy Jr. for an inspiring rally in West Des Moines, IA! We need 500 Iowans for an Assembly to automatically place Mr. Kennedy on the ballot.
[Dallas, Texas](https://www.kennedy24.com/dallas-texas-reception?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=weekly_news_4_10_24_rs_a4&n=3) \- Sunday, April 14th at 4:00 PM
Elevate your support for Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.'s presidential campaign at an intimate fundraising reception. Enjoy delectable hors d’oeuvres and cocktails while partaking in a fireside chat and an inspiring Q&A session.
[Palos Verdes, California](https://www.kennedy24.com/palos-verdes?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=weekly_news_4_10_24_rs_a4&n=4) \- Thursday, April 18th at 6:00 PM
This private reception is an opportunity to see and hear RFK, Jr. up close and personal. It includes remarks by the candidate, an intimate Q&A, and photo opportunity for all.
[Royal Oaks, Michigan](https://www.kennedy24.com/night-of-laughter-detroit?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=weekly_news_4_10_24_rs_a4&n=5) \- Sunday, April 21st at 7:30 PM
We are thrilled to host our second “Night of Laughter with RFK, Jr.” featuring the comic genius of Rob Schneider, Dave Landau, Heather Jay, Mike Binder, Tre Stewart, Erica Rhodes and other surprise guests!
[Scottsdale, Arizona](https://www.kennedy24.com/scottsdale-april-reception?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=weekly_news_4_10_24_rs_a4&n=6) \- Tuesday, April 23rd at 6:00 PM
This exclusive event includes heavy hors d’ oeuvres and cocktails, a fireside chat with Robert F. Kennedy Jr., and a photo opportunity. Don’t miss this special event with a chance to engage RFK Jr. up close.

VIKRAM MANSHARAMANI ANNOUNCES RUN FOR 2nd CONGRESSIONAL DISTRICT

CAMPAIGN WILL FOCUS ON IMMIGRATION AND THE ECONOMY
---
LINCOLN, NH - Today entrepreneur Vikram Mansharamani of Lincoln, NH announced his candidacy for New Hampshire's Second Congressional District.
"Washington, DC is completely dysfunctional. The politicians have made a mess of things and we need to shake things up. Throughout my career I haven't been afraid to push back and speak the truth, whether in the boardroom or the classroom, and that's exactly what I will do in Congress," said Mansharamani. "The last thing America needs is another wishy-washy politician who wants to become a Washington insider. I am running to bring real world experience and solutions to the mess in DC."
Mansharamani continued: "Just look at the uncontrolled flow of people and drugs across our borders. It's a national security disaster that is wreaking havoc in our neighborhoods and destroying our communities. Let me be clear: as the son of legal immigrants, I wholeheartedly believe immigration is good for our country. I believe we need a "Tall Wall and a Wide Gate' - a secure border and a welcoming legal immigration system. But the first step is securing the border."
"Runaway inflation is another example of the dysfunction in DC. The politicians printed, borrowed, and spent too much money. It's time for some fiscal sobriety. We need to stop the out-of-control spending and live within our means. Yes, that means tough choices, but working families and seniors on fixed incomes have to do that every day. If NH families can do it, so can Congress. Further, we need to cut regulations and unleash American entrepreneurial energy to develop the industries of the future, here in America, to compete with China."
"Enough is enough. We must acknowledge that we simply can't do everything. We can't write unlimited checks for never-ending wars, we can't spend billions on illegal immigrants, and we can't keep funding our ever-expanding federal government. Trying to do everything will mean we can't do anything and the people in the Second Congressional District deserve better."
At the end of the day, Mansharamani is running to restore the promise of America: "My parents came to this country to pursue the American Dream," Mansharamani noted. "I have lived that Dream and I want to secure it for our children and grandchildren. America is more than a country, it's a promise - a promise of equal opportunity, not equal outcomes."
Vikram Mansharamani is a businessman who has spent his life creating businesses and helping entrepreneurs and Fortune 500 companies create jobs and grow. The son of two working-class immigrants, Vikram earned scholarships and took out loans to pay for college and graduate school. His mother was a dietician and his father was an auto-mechanic. Vikram's first job was pumping gas at his father's gas station. Vikram lives in Lincoln, NH with his wife of 23 years and their two children.

body:
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=2641%2E552475%2EGl7cIv)
Peter, I wanted to write to you about why I’m running for re-election and why I need your support.
If you don’t need an explanation, you can make a donation at this link: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240410-1?refcode=20240410-1](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240410-1?recurring=1&refcode=em20240410-1&refcode2=2641_552475_Gl7cIv&akid=2641%2E552475%2EGl7cIv)**
Pennsylvania is my home. It’s where I was born, where I grew up, and where Terese and I raised our family.
It’s also where I started a career in public service that has always been about fighting for Pennsylvania families, children, seniors, veterans, and people with disabilities.
Serving the people of our Commonwealth has been my great honor, and I’m running for re-election to continue making progress in the fight for workers’ rights, women’s rights, and voting rights.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240410-1?recurring=1&refcode=em20240410-1&refcode2=2641_552475_Gl7cIv&akid=2641%2E552475%2EGl7cIv)
Since I launched this campaign a year ago, I’ve been traveling across the Commonwealth, from Erie County to Bucks County and everywhere in between, talking with Pennsylvanians about what I’m doing to lower costs for working families, build a stronger economy that works for everyone, and ensure that our seniors have the benefits they've earned.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240410-1?recurring=1&refcode=em20240410-1&refcode2=2641_552475_Gl7cIv&akid=2641%2E552475%2EGl7cIv)
But the reality is that my opponent is the wealthiest self-funder running for Senate anywhere in the country. He has already put $2 million of his own personal fortune into this race, and that is just the beginning.
When you’re up against that kind of cash, you need to build a team of supporters to help fight back and stay competitive. That’s where you come in, Peter.
[**Can I count on you to chip in any amount today to support my campaign? Serving the people of our Commonwealth has been my great honor, and I’m running for re-election to continue making progress in the fight for workers’ rights, women’s rights, and voting rights. Since I launched this campaign a year ago, I’ve been traveling across the Commonwealth, from Erie County to Bucks County and everywhere in between, talking with Pennsylvanians about what I’m doing to lower costs for working families, build a stronger economy that works for everyone, and ensure that our seniors have the benefits they've earned. But the reality is that my opponent is the wealthiest self-funder running for Senate anywhere in the country. He has already put $2 million of his own personal fortune into this race, and that is just the beginning. subject: Let's Secure New Hampshire's Future Together
body:
I need more than just your vote—I need your active support...
| |
---
**Derek** I’m reaching out to you not just as a candidate for Governor, but as a fellow Granite Stater deeply concerned about the future of our beloved state. Over the past months, I’ve shared my vision for a New Hampshire where safety, liberty, and prosperity flourish—a state resilient against the challenges of crime, illegal immigration, and the devastating opioid crisis. Yesterday, I released my plan to fortify New Hampshire from the most dangerous threats that face us. We aim to strengthen our state by ending incentives for illegal immigration, dismantling sanctuary cities, enforcing our laws with vigor, and backing our law enforcement with the resources and support they need. Additionally, we're committed to fighting the opioid epidemic with zero tolerance for fentanyl dealers, recognizing the dire threat they pose to our community. It’s a comprehensive approach that prioritizes the safety and well-being of all Granite Staters, ensuring our state remains a bastion of freedom and security in challenging times. [**This vision, our shared vision, is at the heart of why I’m running for Governor. But to turn our goals into realities, I need more than just your vote—I need your active support.**](https://link.email.chuckmorsefornh.) **Why Every Dollar Counts:** _Our campaign, at its core, is a grassroots movement powered by people like you. Every contribution, no matter the size, fuels our efforts to:_
* **Spread Our Message Far and Wide:** With your help, we can reach every corner of New Hampshire, sharing our plan to strengthen our state’s defenses and support our law enforcement.
* **Empower Our Grassroots Movement:** Your donations provide our tireless volunteers with the resources they need to mobilize, engage, and make a difference.
* **Build a Stronger, Safer Future:** Together, we can implement policies that tackle the opioid epidemic head-on, ensure our communities are safe, and uphold the rule of law.

**How You Can Make a Difference Today:**
* **Make a Contribution:** Whether it’s [$25, $50, $100](https://link.email.chuckmorsefornh.), or any amount you can afford, your donation today is an investment in New Hampshire’s future - [Donate Here](https://link.email.chuckmorsefornh.)!
* **Join Our Monthly Supporters:** Steady support is crucial for long-term planning and execution. Consider [becoming a monthly donor](https://link.email.chuckmorsefornh.) to help us maintain momentum.
* **Spread the Word:** Talk to your friends, family, and neighbors about why you believe in our campaign and encourage them to join our cause.

Time and again, I’ve been inspired by the strength and spirit of our community. Your support has already brought us so far, and as we enter this critical phase of the campaign, your contribution has never been more vital. From the bottom of my heart, thank you for believing in our mission and for your continued support. Together, we can secure a future for New Hampshire that we can all be proud of. **Onward to victory,** **Chuck Morse** [**P.S. Every moment counts as we push forward toward election day. If you're able, please consider making a contribution to our campaign today. Your support could make all the difference.**](https://link.email.chuckmorsefornh.)

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA
body:
you can imagine the dishonor that I felt because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil. | [](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=3ca4c473d77e4528af02a8a90ffed751&_e=eHBwPxIpUrUJAVO5AgQiBof-Bi4HpBRUV17yuH5Fi1HkjL_9tLg93Lx29c5xYw8RQ67OXgVE8WapPKAOeKEbDAT3Us1Xf8YfMjLStD6X5iZOpSbaljMVVrwJKIcl7woKJcisgsUnU1vM2ynM-hM2d6ORbjzHNSFCPi1KD_JNFemT31EQjkREIHxG-ckhDishlwXmqpfWdT-6Sl8r0BAoVPg0YKhTSWnTOqDng-pTFcPLEORdnG94_glGCU1YSffnOZzidnNYQaSiuAkRUdsNezqxVy10ZXe3ryBrY9Wx5V6QAutueupJsTKVIUMax03V9d2Oope164IgD6KjAS1fzX7bs5vjdzIUMq0zejQnL7UsWgqtASArNO5b_ZJtzS-ZHoML0oUG9mk0yiq6KuNHHabWASWZx-otXd3QhTiWqg0%3D)

---
Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=3ca4c473d77e4528af02a8a90ffed751&_e=eHBwPxIpUrUJAVO5AgQiBof-Bi4HpBRUV17yuH5Fi1HkjL_9tLg93Lx29c5xYw8RQ67OXgVE8WapPKAOeKEbDAT3Us1Xf8YfMjLStD6X5iZOpSbaljMVVrwJKIcl7woKJcisgsUnU1vM2ynM-hM2d6ORbjzHNSFCPi1KD_JNFemT31EQjkREIHxG-ckhDishlwXmqpfWdT-6Sl8r0BAoVPg0YKhTSWnTOqDng-pTFcPLEORdnG94_glGCU1YSffniYwhCOH-zp0RGWLGJgvSbLLkTf74DEodYLpA4J5rSV8E23HFkAUbOeiIHZ9p0fRGuCbbUv-2qsuXGXmf9UDD-qJxyxukKGq-uY6uDX2_Mg-3oXXoxB2U5LcWIefisyk6lzemYE8kke7qgSV_Z_hX6jmcJfI4ZiFyKOrwAOGk-ug%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

| | Why has the Democratic Party stopped showing up? The truth is, I don't think anyone really knows, but there are many opinions. If you talk to the Democratic Party or Democratic campaigns, the answer is standard: not enough votes, not enough money, the cost is too high or our role is to win elections. However, this narrative is false and self-fulfilled by not showing up. By minimizing rural America, the Democratic Party has effectively handed over rural voters to the far-right, allowing them to wield significant political power.
So what is this cost that is too high? It is $1,200, that's it. The estimated cost to get a young or non-Black person of color to vote Democrat is $1,200 ([Politico/April 1, 2024](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/c7Ox3prre/c?w=kQlu30d9lcfauHyvT3RyMzYhryWKBd26uL5RMceZ0QM.)). Rural Americans United has estimated, based on our pro-Democratic messaging campaign, to be closer to $25 per person, reflecting a long-term strategy of education and trust-building.

# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1328%2E135344%2EEmqIoH)

Team, I am incredibly disappointed.
Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.
They are enforcing a near-total ban on abortion that was originally passed before Arizona was even a state, in 1864, during the Civil War.
No exceptions for rape. No exceptions for incest.
As a father, I am fearful for my daughter. As an Arizonan, I am fearful for the people of my state. And as an American, I am absolutely furious that this has come to pass.
It’s not lost on me that this happened because of the Supreme Court that Donald Trump built, and because the Senate failed to act to protect abortion rights when they had the chance.
It’s a dark day, but this is NOT over.
If I make it to the Senate I will do everything I can to pass legislation that will make the protections provided by Roe v. Wade the law of the land -- including reforming the filibuster.
I’m a Marine, and I’ll fight alone if I have to. But we’ll accomplish a lot more together. So please, if you’re looking for a way to channel your anger into action, consider supporting my campaign.
[**Split a donation between my campaign and Elissa Slotkin today and we will direct every dollar you send to us towards protecting choice and keeping Arizona and Michigan blue. Any amount helps.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=em-slotkin-gallego-apr24.iofnJT&refcode=em240410-1-15&t=2&akid=1328%2E135344%2EEmqIoH)**

**_"I hope Nancy gets the help she needs. I really do... She’s got a lot of challenges." -FORMER Speaker of the House, Kevin McCarthy_**

This aint my first rodeo, Peter.

I’m used to people underestimating me. _Truly!_

I didn’t become the first woman to graduate from The Citadel's Corps of Cadets by having a lot of people believe in me.

I didn’t pick myself up after dropping out of high school and go waitress at Waffle House to put food on the table because of handouts.

I didn’t become a strong conservative FIGHTER in Washington DC because I didn’t face challenges.

**_NOPE!_**

I got to where I am because I am a fighter. I’m not afraid to get dirt under my fingernails and sweat on my brow for the things that I believe in. _**And I believe in America.**_ I will fight until the day I die for what is RIGHT in this country – _and I’m not a sell-out to corporate greed like the former Speaker._

Which is why he is coming after me on his revenge tour. I can’t be bought. My vote is not for sale. I work for the American people and the American people ONLY. _Which frankly scares the HECK out of people here in Washington who aren’t used to people they cannot control._

**So, today, I’m taking the former Speaker’s advice:** [**I’m asking for help._Not from lobbyists or party leaders but from the people I work for._ Help from you, Peter.**](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=e81d02ea5b384a0290035e5de91ac43f&_e=Dk8k3c0HH6gfbfPmNcuHrs11WtulzJN4pvQ3rKiag5LIcEZxrQyTkOgXeI3sPED6AoxLHEotReNldTKH41VhT7aK11W13oOO22AdqXEpsYgw_UR1XtOdAqRO-3GhdRmWnDwHbjjDc10OcnuLqin7_Gwg9LWfbESCCcj6lfx41YjlCC_9--6WL5TzhsqWFmx0k0J602vYKL7ll9xo-EadxdtSRhJ9eVpr8XKgYGtxYNx5czfdjHcCM__2xAssWuLp5I1mFBS1pdJDVxNgdAmZEGqTXPO6kNNknH9ZUX211ndS0Pmh8UxEnAHjLhW8pDMx7IoltzZg06EwZocKIL7MRfsEGOgKj5Qg9897XHzY4TdWY5y0Dk7m6CEHV1kKfz6P)

Everyone in Washington is after me. **My career in public service began as a teenager.**
When I joined the Iowa National Guard, I started with an ambush. I brought an Army Recruiter home to meet my parents because they had to cosign my papers to join the military at 17.
But my family’s history of service started before me, with my dad in Laos, working for USAID during the Vietnam War. My dad became a marked man for his efforts aiding the Americans and he escaped to a refugee camp with my mom and sisters.
Eventually, this great country and the generous people of Iowa welcomed my family and many thousands of Tai Dam refugees to this state. Our family was grateful for the opportunity to be in America and my love of country developed early. I wanted to give back and that’s why I joined the military.
After 9/11, my Iowa National Guard unit was activated and we deployed to Afghanistan in 2004. As a combat engineer, I was focused on explosive demolitions and force protection in and around Kandahar.
I was proud of my service and grateful to make it home. This experience strengthened my determination to continue serving our country.
**It’s been the honor of my life serving this country.**
I was born and raised in Mount Pleasant, Iowa. I went to public school, community college, and following my deployment earned my degree from Drake University using the G.I. Bill. During the Obama administration, I had the opportunity to join Secretary Vilsack’s team in the U.S. Department of Agriculture.
At USDA, I helped to expand economic opportunities for farmers in Iowa and across the country. I also lead the department’s veterans outreach program, helping thousands of transitioning service members learn about opportunities in farming, ranching, and agriculture.
I met my wife in Iowa and now we’re raising our daughter here. We live just blocks away from where my wife grew up. Our daughter goes to the same elementary school that my wife did as a kid.
Serving this great state and our country isn’t just a privilege — _it’s an honor and should be done by those who believe in the power of strengthening our communities for everyone._
I know Iowans are tired of partisan political games and the dysfunction in Congress. We deserve so much better than extreme politicians who care more about their power and their next election than serving the people across our state.

subject: I miss the 1800s
body:

Peter, Yesterday the Arizona Supreme Court announced that they were reviving Arizona's 1864 ban on abortions. When I said that abortion should be left up to the states, this is exactly what I wanted. It's great to some essential laws get revived. But why stop at abortion? In addition to bringing women's rights back to the 18th century, let's start enforcing some more crazy laws. **Here are some Ohio laws that were never repealed that I would like to see enforced.** In the entire State of Ohio, it's against the law to kill a housefly within 160 feet of a church. How could the radical left not enforce this essential statute? In the entire State, it's legal to throw a snake at someone but not to shake a snake at someone. That's a great new election day tactic. Anyone who votes for Biden, we throw a snake at. No one may be arrested on Sunday or on the Fourth of July. Darn. Should have done January 6th on a Sunday. It's illegal to run out of gas. Good. I hate poor people. Just take a damn helicopter.
When I become President again, we're going right back to the 19th century. I haven't even gotten started on how great their divorce laws were. body:

---
Friend, in just a moment we’re going to ask you to make a donation to Ruben Gallego’s campaign for Senate. But before we do, let us explain why this donation and this moment are so incredibly important.
Yesterday, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from 1864 that will impose a near-total ban on abortion without exceptions for rape and incest on the people of Arizona.
Millions of Arizonans just lost rights that their grandmothers and mothers were born with.

Stacey Shaffer, M.D.

body:
Fellow Conservative,

It's Kellyanne Conway reaching out to have a frank discussion with you ahead of the pivotal 2024 general election. Believe it or not, we are less than eight months until voters head to the polls to help save our nation and get this country back on track.

If you feel like we're living in a time warp and Election Day 2020 just came to an end, believe me, you're not alone.

While so much has changed under Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, the cost of living and crime have increased, so much has stayed the same.

1. Americans _still want_ lower taxes. \*\*tap here if you agree!\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=4548119.2003.1.cfbb698ee6ae40e76057a4fa5cf8c72b )

2. Americans are _still fighting_ for safer communities in which to raise their families. \*\*tap here if you agree!\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=4548119.2004.1.b409840475bd374a373edad4fcb0e014 )

3. And Americans simply want enough cash in their bank accounts to pay their bills and have a little fun. \*\*tap here if you agree!\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=4548119.2005.1.60662931efc1671532641aabc54c5df2 )

Under President Trump and Republican leadership in Congress, the voting public was more confident in their ability to live out their American Dream. But under the so-called "leadership" of President Biden and Montana U.S. Sen. Jon Tester, Americans are frustrated and fed up with the lackluster economy and weakness on the world stage.

\*\*That's why I am writing to you in support of Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy, the leading candidate to replace failed D.C. insider Jon Tester. ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=4548119.2006.1.1937cda9e034cca2b3a2e3c1ebe5a440 )\*\* The contrast between these two individuals is clear: one is a bonafide American hero, while the other has made a living doing the bidding of Democrat party elders.

I know that Tim has been reaching out to you for months. I also know that some of my friends in the U.S. Senate have been reaching out to you, too. But I want to make sure you hear it from me: \*\*Tim is our best shot at beating Jon Tester and flipping the Senate majority, yet his fundraising numbers are lower than they ought to be, while Biden-supporting Democrat and phony Jon Tester has a massive warchest. ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=4548119.2007.1.e14471c772b0f2e9ac1b3b50bb881c83 )\*\*

You could say that I know a thing or two about polling – and \*\*_polling shows that with adequate resources, Tim can defeat Jon Tester and flip a Senate seat Republicans have been chasing after since 2006._\*\*

->\*\*send a contribution right now

Help me help Tim\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=4548119.2008.1.d1b97a33422b98470cf0253afa3f6114 )<-

Right now, it's time to channel our frustrations into defeating the DEMS at the ballot box next November. And I'm not just talking about Joe Biden and Kamala Harris – I'm talking about all Democrats, namely fake "moderate" Jon Tester.

Chuck Grassley emailed you.

Marco Rubio emailed you.

Marsha Blackburn emailed you.

Steve Daines emailed you.

\*\*Now I am asking you to join me in helping to ensure our candidates have the resources ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=4548119.2009.1.decf18dfc9b28e632186891ea046a7c5 )\*\* we need to defeat the Leftist agenda, Biden and his allies.

\*\*The time is NOW. I need you to do this for me, Navy Seal Tim Sheehy, and for America. ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=4548119.2010.1.6776d1cddfd5d143b900f5271ac5a965 )\*\*

Let's get it done.

God bless you.

( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=4548119.2011.1.07374505ac7d82b1eb01f3abac378f90 )

Kellyanne Conway

body:
Arizona is just the latest state to ban abortion care.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82742800/466210457/-849459103?refcode=ea.a5b79fd7-4cf7-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&ms=ea.a5b79fd7-4cf7-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNWI3OWZkNy00Y2Y3LWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qXoNt5qyR495fjsep6AkH2Fwr6SFxtP7AN4p9MGMSdo=&emci=7037414b-41f7-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&emdi=a5b79fd7-4cf7-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&ceid=46764483)
---
**_In every single state where they have power, Republicans are telling women that our lives are less important than their agenda of extremism._** Arizona just became the latest state to virtually ban abortion — the state Supreme Court revived a law from _1864_ that prohibits abortion care and threatens medical practitioners with prison time. No matter where we live, every single person deserves the right to decide if, when, and how to have a family. And it’s crystal clear that the only way to restore women’s right to bodily autonomy from Tennessee to Texas to Arizona is with federal legislation and a Democratic Senate that will codify the protections of _Roe v. Wade_. **_[I urgently need your support for my campaign to defeat my anti-abortion opponent and get to Washington to fight for your rights. Please, chip in right away.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82742803/466210460/-1218973835?refcode=ea.a5b79fd7-4cf7-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&ms=ea.a5b79fd7-4cf7-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNWI3OWZkNy00Y2Y3LWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qXoNt5qyR495fjsep6AkH2Fwr6SFxtP7AN4p9MGMSdo=)_** The GOP’s policies on reproductive rights are stuck a hundred years in the past, and we _will not_ sit by and accept further reversals of our hard-won rights. Democrats in Washington are committed to restoring and securing reproductive freedom, but Republicans are standing in our way — even though women are _suffering_ in states with abortion bans. It's true, friend

Friend,

It's pretty bold of Joe Biden to stand up in front of the American people and continuously dismiss the crisis on the southern border...
_**[Because illegal immigration is by far the _NUMBER ONE ISSUE_ in voters' minds according to polling.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0a18796812c14fb08a86ce20ccc58921&_e=qM6ugSJ_xVtBB1Yjw0ouNBSDEvBClHNq7gKHs68l9B-94kx8sFvg6TohhPnrbmpJlCjarl7H1XoTsC3ZFStqWHzgCgmt72wDXRJzTkjTiCA9c2o3CTe1ALaUneegYtmB14h81AqobMXTaohzcKKUV2U3g0P9qKKZEVlslIXHoGC2y9oRD87Vi8Hz_xCpuK8Ulr5BilYyhYii5sQLyhNb2spf4VUBB_IyHnKQAQdSFvo1FTXYZCjsYLk9El23_D_uG1PWXQMoh0bQtNKf3-rI-yzFcoVyA9D9jRYAXAkIZxTdh_grW7LFLnEJuhE6hxbjVTIKYKlNtr1w7OAaHTGMy7fd7dJ4lycSmPHPPLqpST91hbCq2PY0pC1zFfnybzFhxqZm8jl8OKcxugHB_T-8lTJTidw5mf8ElrIY9qh1zDGxF1UiUT8JHTfq6TSsZgCSfT-KL4Z_-xfJl3j6Cb7t1IJzPEhLDmVHn6xzxGOpUz6X48ufLZDCQFJqtsv-LCjq9lLTAehuQhgZaB73x9vqJw%3D%3D)**_

| For years, Trump has made me public enemy number one because I have effectively held him to account.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=6201%2E5257348%2ETzuAaq)
Derek —
Under any other circumstance, a candidate for president invoking violence and insults against political rivals would be grounds for disqualification and disdain from voters.
**But not for Donald Trump.**
Most recently, Trump has posted videos depicting violence against President Biden.
Over and over again, Donald Trump uses his huge platform to go after his rivals — and once he sounds off on them, his army of online MAGA trolls continues the attacks.
It’s vicious and dangerous. And Derek, I know firsthand how it feels.
For _years_ , Trump has made me public enemy number one because I have effectively held him to account.
From my service as chairman of the House Intelligence Committee to my work as impeachment manager in his first trial to my time on the January 6 Select Committee, I have been persistent in my work to hold Trump to account.
And Trump knows how effective I am. Which is why he’s insulted me repeatedly. Called me out personally on the campaign stage and on cable news. And unleashed his online army to go after me.
Derek, if Donald Trump becomes president once more, he will use and abuse his powers for his own gain — even more than he did during his first term.
The attacks and insults on social media will not end, even if he holds the title of President of the United States. **That’s why I’m doing all I can to prevent him from making it there — and in the Senate, I will continue to hold him accountable.**
**[Derek, as Donald Trump continues to use the rhetoric of violence on social media, I am relentlessly holding him to account so voters know the danger he poses to our country. Friends,
In 1864, medical professionals didn't know about infections. They used ether or chloroform for anesthesia and treated wounds with amputation. It was 20 years before they mistook cocaine as a painkiller.
In 1864, women couldn't vote. They had just received legal control over their wages, which, if they worked, were half of a man's.
There are laws from centuries ago that make sense, e.g., our constitution, but we should not be taking reproductive healthcare cues from the Civil War.
Now, after the defeat of Roe v. Wade, Arizona's draconian law will be back on the books, which will implement a total ban on abortion across the state.
The GOP is taking America backwards by 160 years.
Only 6% of Arizonans said abortion should be illegal in all cases. This law specifies all cases unless to save the life of the woman. Without federal protection of women's rights, this is how states will trample on choice.
My opponent, Rep. Jack Bergman, supports this oppression. I do not. It's time to rally together and fight draconian policy.
Friends, thank you for contributing to that cause.
Onward,
Dr. Bob
