body:
When I saw everything that we’d worked for in Afghanistan washed away in a matter of days, I decided to consider serving in government once again | [](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=4d733b4827724c2ab28a79830d5b0d41&_e=KX2B4_W2s9OfSxXqMQC9WiGggWLgh1vUasUGR3ghTg1EsaunyzMo-acAzrVgfsUW-eIHmx_hHGnn_WvOLTCUyW0ubMIf4RpmwSK1CON_ZsmRuRzg9UFI9zajwjWMZOiyl_UrGQOjrGoNavPLm5jdemGSWtPTCWqbLys1COouvZZzV3cy7_XGxvqpYGt3027RhoPhhJMJxCxMbnppCUWogutibnP91CDWubKDO-avZzQIc3pfbVyWRfGiTRdhNbDqTVG1FamiXpDLoj1AY6s5B9QW1NPFWlGjokNdrV7leW_KS6Cx6ju1wf1SenhlzzDSl1uwXcv04A9wERfhNzL_Llw_PQ3Ocn3i4tPKk6jF_Z2sSWCaBxZ2yMGYDcTNHN0GKI9OoRh2LS5INNrM4JV9uQaAEEzHok6COh8evLqtO7g%3D)

---
Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=4d733b4827724c2ab28a79830d5b0d41&_e=KX2B4_W2s9OfSxXqMQC9WiGggWLgh1vUasUGR3ghTg1EsaunyzMo-acAzrVgfsUW-eIHmx_hHGnn_WvOLTCUyW0ubMIf4RpmwSK1CON_ZsmRuRzg9UFI9zajwjWMZOiyl_UrGQOjrGoNavPLm5jdemGSWtPTCWqbLys1COouvZZzV3cy7_XGxvqpYGt3027RhoPhhJMJxCxMbnppCUWogutibnP91CDWubKDO-avZzQIc3pfbVyWRfGiTRdhNbDqTVG1FamiXpDLoj1AY6s5B5vkgDG7N8jMsj375tYPF3RM-kzl4Qa-ekssEdeZ1yJDTtEnafL79D1YgDnpdCjsBSX___ozi5Cj2dH6SNyA5P2a7h5Qs_waP7DHswO3sfOy9l4a5Qs3Vg4wyafIBRu8klKnWILOeLdznVvWi0JJzSU%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=4d733b4827724c2ab28a79830d5b0d41&_e=KX2B4_W2s9OfSxXqMQC9WiGggWLgh1vUasUGR3ghTg1EsaunyzMo-acAzrVgfsUW-eIHmx_hHGnn_WvOLTCUyW0ubMIf4RpmwSK1CON_ZsmRuRzg9UFI9zajwjWMZOiyl_UrGQOjrGoNavPLm5jdemGSWtPTCWqbLys1COouvZZzV3cy7_XGxvqpYGt3027RhoPhhJMJxCxMbnppCUWogutibnP91CDWubKDO-avZzQIc3pfbVyWRfGiTRdhNbDqTVG1FamiXpDLoj1AY6s5Bz5Hcu4WOMGWY2_JKOLD4T3uHUW8NQfGCqxcj_W5TylUn-IOPw4ftNayXHQpHtIwZXwjJDPAQscos-rkEwM6acR0KzekeMrQPNKYBUropnF-CUiawwFaFaNvMXaduDVvTNTJTeeWCsnS-oK_QiVFeyw%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.** If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, **[please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=4d733b4827724c2ab28a79830d5b0d41&_e=KX2B4_W2s9OfSxXqMQC9WiGggWLgh1vUasUGR3ghTg1EsaunyzMo-acAzrVgfsUWuTHruuDRC7OHs8zfBhDd7cmB6ADSoJuhPlxM_IVNaoOrRi3cxGKKwRszbiKthEEk5p75dd2naJiWSd-xDKkoh7y1qVFzwEa4V-_P5lamkWLkEFj9xyCtUeyWn2QN-f0K_jyMDN9xQim7coAB5BWtkF6OIpFbuJFmGMTKkmxyFnXmjJPnrTczljw9pUl1ImGdrFdj9jX_kKjNZ7lw_piXDeHVeZ1wZc3Zi8ZYzjRYRbBx9OTRtmnygeUn0FP97hwv_i3siFQKRYo7ZQQkZ9lOQKecIyfq0RAped2vs5WNfab3t6AgI0oc8seYagQc2yQB_F28W9nHbgUms_8fjZp1Hkn5zrIbMNs8Bmka8yrCHT4%3D)** ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

[**JOIN OUR FIGHT
ENLIST WITH TIM TODAY->** ](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=4d733b4827724c2ab28a79830d5b0d41&_e=KX2B4_W2s9OfSxXqMQC9WiGggWLgh1vUasUGR3ghTg1EsaunyzMo-acAzrVgfsUW-eIHmx_hHGnn_WvOLTCUyW0ubMIf4RpmwSK1CON_ZsmRuRzg9UFI9zajwjWMZOiyl_UrGQOjrGoNavPLm5jdemGSWtPTCWqbLys1COouvZZzV3cy7_XGxvqpYGt3027RhoPhhJMJxCxMbnppCUWogutibnP91CDWubKDO-avZzQIc3pfbVyWRfGiTRdhNbDqTVG1FamiXpDLoj1AY6s5B0lxZMDBiC_pSX06JHtNt3-j927ywHO0Axn3D-dQRPs37I2EDMmn2RwetKfFeYx-GU6bGmAfRfpBiqsnxoPFFtNLvHrk1jNqVNu0FJJGt3RAJdk_ppDc1Yy0uX5s2LcUAlK0RjTlf_flGjfCGeQq-Ho%3D)

It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; **but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. **

[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=4d733b4827724c2ab28a79830d5b0d41&_e=KX2B4_W2s9OfSxXqMQC9WiGggWLgh1vUasUGR3ghTg1EsaunyzMo-acAzrVgfsUW-eIHmx_hHGnn_WvOLTCUyW0ubMIf4RpmwSK1CON_ZsmRuRzg9UFI9zajwjWMZOiyl_UrGQOjrGoNavPLm5jdemGSWtPTCWqbLys1COouvZZzV3cy7_XGxvqpYGt3027RhoPhhJMJxCxMbnppCUWogutibnP91CDWubKDO-avZzQIc3pfbVyWRfGiTRdhNbDqTVG1FamiXpDLoj1AY6s5B0RyO7Y62FXBD9yAxLdliQr1i5imUu5QK-l8zTyJIEZNsaT3EhxLLEyRREMa05jose-ww-2H6nLM-ceg7E9Jdhv4tpjoXI_CZ3Q8ZCXfGY4-4Ybz5bNwzEB9QDOuaEOVcIES7MRh2A_JUzCOMzzsm_E%3D)
**Unlike Joe Biden, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield.** I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. [**ENLIST WITH TIM
CONFIRM YOUR SUPPORT TODAY->** ](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=4d733b4827724c2ab28a79830d5b0d41&_e=KX2B4_W2s9OfSxXqMQC9WiGggWLgh1vUasUGR3ghTg1EsaunyzMo-acAzrVgfsUW-eIHmx_hHGnn_WvOLTCUyW0ubMIf4RpmwSK1CON_ZsmRuRzg9UFI9zajwjWMZOiyl_UrGQOjrGoNavPLm5jdemGSWtPTCWqbLys1COouvZZzV3cy7_XGxvqpYGt3027RhoPhhJMJxCxMbnppCUWogutibnP91CDWubKDO-avZzQIc3pfbVyWRfGiTRdhNbDqTVG1FamiXpDLoj1AY6s5B8VzKYyCGIVx3-y3TALGV-mFRBMLhU58Exe37XytTbbRG7CA2190MjRnJLZyOx1BrBHb848y26A6piQXAfByI43Oii0HOyHS6id4WOPwsJXTV9dkJozS2wX8JAwtZHT1La7EcPaFDuL_KxS8vXsaMk8%3D)

I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, **[I’m going to need the help of every conservative donor who reads this letter.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=4d733b4827724c2ab28a79830d5b0d41&_e=KX2B4_W2s9OfSxXqMQC9WiGggWLgh1vUasUGR3ghTg1EsaunyzMo-acAzrVgfsUW-eIHmx_hHGnn_WvOLTCUyW0ubMIf4RpmwSK1CON_ZsmRuRzg9UFI9zajwjWMZOiyl_UrGQOjrGoNavPLm5jdemGSWtPTCWqbLys1COouvZZzV3cy7_XGxvqpYGt3027RhoPhhJMJxCxMbnppCUWogutibnP91CDWubKDO-avZzQIc3pfbVyWRfGiTRdhNbDqTVG1FamiXpDLoj1AY6s5ByxemlFQQFRsloSh4BDGx8g8mwE_24ck16j11upBF8_U338fRkD0wN7O-6vbcw_cT4YqutvY4p4_UErKbKYpQ7vy6hQz7lqI5wqLKLdEVC8b6Ygd52QqBuPApDDiwVcZRy1f7oYIc5TC7wo9KfnFTuo%3D) **

Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes.

We fought in Iraq, _**I was there.**_ We fought in Afghanistan, _**I was there.**_

And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times.

I want to look at my children and tell them, _**“Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.”**_

[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=4d733b4827724c2ab28a79830d5b0d41&_e=KX2B4_W2s9OfSxXqMQC9WiGggWLgh1vUasUGR3ghTg1EsaunyzMo-acAzrVgfsUW-eIHmx_hHGnn_WvOLTCUyW0ubMIf4RpmwSK1CON_ZsmRuRzg9UFI9zajwjWMZOiyl_UrGQOjrGoNavPLm5jdemGSWtPTCWqbLys1COouvZZzV3cy7_XGxvqpYGt3027RhoPhhJMJxCxMbnppCUWogutibnP91CDWubKDO-avZzQIc3pfbVyWRfGiTRdhNbDqTVG1FamiXpDLoj1AY6s5B9wY_toaOj69KLxdDj9Qp3j2JIhlaUAfQVtdwZ6wiliIkC29oTUKItg4E6sg7S13PsIbF_3BUHwqTt45LKmFNZ3-43offCsockyM3yAtlwRuL0uGY--rH5p9N_sZBvAqUjVxTCJmmeochSwb_pdf1W4%3D)
**But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it.**

So, Fellow Conservative \- that’s what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting to restore faith in our American way of life. I entered the political arena to ensure the sacrifices my friends made weren’t made in vain.

[**HELP ME FLIP THIS SEAT

clean_body: When I saw everything that we’d worked for in Afghanistan washed away in a matter of days, I decided to consider serving in government once again | Fellow Conservative, As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams. Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, those are the traits that define me. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead. This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, “I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’” Every day it got worse. Every day it was a disaster. The adult in the room never materialized. Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport. Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.” I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil. If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right. If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy. It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. Unlike Joe Biden, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield. I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes. We fought in Iraq, I was there. We fought in Afghanistan, I was there. And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times. I want to look at my children and tell them, “Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.” But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it. So, Fellow Conservative \- that’s what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting to restore faith in our American way of life. I entered the political arena to ensure the sacrifices my friends made weren’t made in vain. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Last month, we launched a coalition of 20+ progressive groups united to
demand the Democratic Party reject AIPAC, but you might be wondering, who
is AIPAC anyway?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240410.epkKEc&refcode=em20240410-34231&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=34231%2E1203867%2EflGmxs ]If you already know the deal about AIPAC and want to fuel our work to
stop their dangerous influence in Washington, chip in here.

Otherwise, here’s an explainer on AIPAC and why we’re taking them on:

AIPAC stands for the American Israel Public Affairs Committee, a lobby
group founded in the 1950s to build bipartisan support for Israel in
Congress.

For most of AIPAC’s existence, it didn’t get involved in elections. They
didn’t need to. But following the groundbreaking elections of AOC, Rashida
Tlaib, Ilhan Omar, and Ayanna Pressley, Congress for the first time had
members willing to speak out for Palestinian human rights. The Democratic
base began to shift on the issue, recognizing Israel’s apartheid rule over
Palestinians.

As a result, in 2021 AIPAC formed its own PAC and Super PAC known as
United Democracy Project (UDP) that waded into Democratic primaries,
spending millions against progressive, pro-peace candidates like Summer
Lee and Ilhan Omar.

Let’s be clear: AIPAC’s campaign spending is a sign of weakness.
Unconditional support for Israel’s far-right government has been
significantly weakened, particularly among Democratic voters. AIPAC’s
tactic of last resort is to threaten to spend millions of dollars to
silence anyone who may speak out for Palestinian human rights.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240410.epkKEc&refcode=em20240410-34231&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=34231%2E1203867%2EflGmxs ]That’s why it’s so important that we have the Squad’s back. We can’t
let AIPAC’s fear tactics work. Chip in now to help us reject AIPAC and
re-elect the Squad in 2024.

So where does AIPAC’s funding come from? While they claim to be
bipartisan, AIPAC is fueled by massive donations from millionaires and
billionaires, including right-wing megadonors who’ve donated to Donald
Trump, Ron DeSantis, and Nikki Haley. The same people trying to re-elect
Trump are bankrolling AIPAC’s primaries against the Squad.

AIPAC’s dark money influence is widespread: last cycle, only 33 out of 535
members of Congress did not receive money from the group's network. Who
AIPAC targets, however, is a narrow group of candidates and elected
officials. AIPAC’s Super PAC exclusively spends against Democrats in
primaries — particularly young, Black and brown progressive champions like
the Squad. In fact, more than 85% of the money UDP (AIPAC’s Super PAC) has
spent has been against candidates of color.

Not only that, but AIPAC has ardently endorsed and contributed to 109
Republican insurrectionists who denied the 2020 election results, as well
as more than 200 anti-abortion Republican extremists. They recently
congratulated retiring Senate Minority Leader Mitch McConnell on a job
well done for his decades of work stonewalling progress, stacking the
SCOTUS with Republicans, and pushing a far-right agenda.

All in all, AIPAC is a right-wing organization, and it’s our job to build
a movement to expose their right-wing agenda to all voters so that they
are rejected by the Democratic Party, following the same path as other
lobby groups like the NRA.

That fight starts now. AIPAC and its affiliates are going all-out to try
and take down the Squad and any other Democrat who expresses support for a
ceasefire and peace in Gaza. Last year, they announced plans to spend an
unprecedented $100 million in this year’s elections. They’ve already run
attack ads against Jamaal Bowman, Summer Lee, and Cori Bush while
hand-picking their primary opponents.

Enough is enough. It is time for the Democratic Party as a whole to do
what’s right and stand up against AIPAC’s threat to our democracy.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240410.epkKEc&refcode=em20240410-34231&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=34231%2E1203867%2EflGmxs ]We’re fighting back against AIPAC’s attacks on the Squad while pushing
for ALL Democratic candidates to reject their dark money once and for all:
will you pitch in $5 or whatever you can to support our
Reject AIPAC campaign?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240410.epkKEc&refcode=em20240410-34231&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1022&akid=34231%2E1203867%2EflGmxs ]Contribute $5

We’ve defeated AIPAC and its millions of dollars of right-wing megadonor
money before — now more than ever, we need to do it again, and we need to
put an end to their interference in our Democratic elections.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20240410-34231-footer&t=1023&refcode2=34231_1203867_flGmxs&akid=34231%2E1203867%2EflGmxs

The Arizona Supreme Court just decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.

Peter, I am incredibly disappointed.

Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.

They are enforcing a near-total ban on abortion that was originally passed before Arizona was even a state, in 1864, during the Civil War.

**No exceptions for rape. No exceptions for incest. **

As a father, I am fearful for my daughter. As an Arizonan, I am fearful for the people of my state. And as an American, I am absolutely furious that this has come to pass.

It’s not lost on me that this happened because of the Supreme Court, and because the Senate failed to act to protect abortion rights when they had the chance.
It’s a dark day, but this is **NOT** over.

If I make it to the Senate I will do everything I can to pass legislation that will make the protections provided by Roe v. Wade the law of the land — including reforming the filibuster if that’s what it takes.

I’m a Marine, and I’ll fight alone if I have to. But we’ll accomplish a lot more together. So please, if you’re looking for a way to channel your anger into action, consider supporting my campaign.

Peter,
Earlier this year, explosive reporting revealed that Josh Hawley pioneered the legal arguments that led to shutdowns of IVF clinics in Alabama. Those arguments are now threatening access to IVF across the country, including in Missouri.
**Hawley is even refusing to support real efforts in the U.S. Senate to protect IVF.**
This issue is personal to so many Missourians. IVF is how they’ve been able to build their families, usually after they’ve faced health challenges or complications. And now, control-obsessed politicians like Hawley want to take that option away.
**Please watch our campaign’s new TV ad holding him accountable, then[chip in whatever you can afford so we can keep this message in front of voters.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/45215?refcode=em20240410-5245&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5245%2E614464%2EEohF9O)**

Wade, co-sponsored a national abortion ban, fought to restrict access to contraceptives, and even orchestrated judicial corruption to ban the most commonly used abortion pill in all 50 states.
Now, his crusade is putting the future of Missouri families in jeopardy.
**I’m running to replace Josh Hawley because I want everyday Missourians to have the power to decide how to build and raise their families.**
In addition to protecting IVF, I want to codify Roe v. Wade, end Missouri’s total abortion ban, and put a stop to the creepy Big Brother attacks on reproductive rights by control-obsessed politicians like Hawley once and for all.
**With so much on the line, none of us can afford another six years of Josh Hawley’s crusade against reproductive freedom.** But if we’re able to reach voters with this message early and often, I know we can flip this seat and take back power for working people this November. name: Mariela Roca
subject: Re: Removing Conservative Candidates from Platform
body:
| | | | | |
---
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=2bafee0b3a&e=0a12281e0e)
This week we received the following notification from CallHub, a Digital Organizing, Campaigning & Canvassing Platform for Political campaigns that we have been using since 2021:
| | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
This company has decided to remove us from their platform because our campaign is for a Republican candidate and we don’t “align with their values”.
Our campaign had been using Call Hub since 2021 during our last race as we were looking for options to be able to send text messages at a lower cost and in ways we could internally send messages and make phone calls without having to outsource this process to a company where we would have to pay more for the service.
Fast forward to May 2023 when CallHub decided to make their “values” public. In which they state they only work with Democrat candidates.
We didn’t realize this since we have been using this service for a few years and have not had any prior issues with this. CallHub was more than happy to approve our political campaign knowing we were Republican in August 2023.
They approved the account as a Republican candidate after their so-called “values” were published. So what has changed now?
My thought is that they are monitoring us and now know that we have a real chance at winning this seat and pose a threat to the “liberal” and “progressive” candidates they support.
While we are happy that we now know who we were inadvertently doing business with, it now leaves our campaign in a predicament where now 30 days before the election we need to scramble to find another service and get re-certified as a political entity to be able to send these messages and reach voters. This all costs money and takes time away from everything we had planned for the next 30 days.
It’s sad that conservative candidates continue to be silenced and censored by companies like this. But we are going to push forward and adapt and overcome like we always do.
Please consider helping the campaign out today by donating to our text message fund below so we can get our texting service back and running today without any delay. Donate by clicking below. ⬇️
[DONATE TO THE TEXT MESSAGE FUND](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=e94b9bc2f3&e=0a12281e0e)
# Postcards and Mailers on the way to voter mailboxes! 💌
| | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
Very excited to announce that our very first batch of postcards and mailers have been sent and are on the way to voters across the 6th district!
Our Amazing Team Roca volunteers have been handwriting postcards for the last couple of months and it truly has been a labor of love. We have already been receiving feedback from voters who have already started receiving postcards and they are truly making an impact.
We have also sent out our first batch of 10,000 mailers to Republican absentee voters in the district. Absentee ballots have already been mailed by the state of Maryland, and it was crucial that our campaign get these out on time.
We still have work to do with sending postcards and mailers. Our goal is to send at least 3K more postcards and 20K mailers to voters. This is one of the parts of the campaign that cost a lot of money to complete.
If you would like to help us with our last batch of postcards and mailers, please consider donating to our postcard and mailer fund by clicking below. ⬇️
[DONATE TO POSTCARD & MAILER FUND](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=2e83e75df1&e=0a12281e0e)
# Upcoming Meet & Greets 🤝🏼
| | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
Our remaining Meet & Greet events for the primary election have been scheduled! We will be meeting at Ledo Pizza in Frederick on April 16th and Bistro 11 & Lounge on April 23rd. These are the last planned events to come meet Mariela and hear what great things the campaign is working on, and how we plan to WIN in 2024. If you are in the area and interested in attending, please visit our events page by clicking below. ⬇️
[EVENTS PAGE](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=f907207c62&e=0a12281e0e)
# Fundraising 🙏🏽
With absentee ballots set to be mailed out by the state of Maryland starting on or after March 30th, we are facing a tight deadline to ensure our message reaches every voter in our district. To make this happen, we must raise a minimum of $20,000 by April 20th in order to get our materials out in time.
Your contribution today will play a crucial role in funding our outreach efforts, including mailers, text messages, phone calls, and postcards. Here is what our campaign needs help with in the next 30 days to get over the finish line:
1. **Postcard Mailing:** $3,000
2. **Mailer:** $8,000
3. **Door Hangers:** $1,000
4. **Texting:** $2,000
5. **Digital Advertising:** $6,000

We understand that these are challenging times, but the future of our district and country is at stake. We need your help now more than ever. Please consider donating today to help us get through the primary election on May 14th here in Maryland.
Every dollar you contribute will bring us one step closer to ensuring a Republican victory in November for Maryland 6th, one of the most crucial races in the country that can decide our House Majority!
Please click on the link below to make your secure contribution:
[**rocaforcongress.com/donate**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=62c60ef40f&e=0a12281e0e)
The future of our Republican majority in the House of Representatives hangs in the balance. We cannot afford to lose sight of the importance of securing seats like Maryland's 6th Congressional District if we want to keep a Republican majority in the House of Representatives. 🇺🇸
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=64a5c879a2&e=0a12281e0e)
Sincerely,
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=2a838b1d84&e=0a12281e0e)
Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for Congress MD-06U.S. Air Force Veteran
|
---
# More about Mariela Roca
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=aecfd750eb&e=0a12281e0e)
My name is Mariela Roca. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for Congress here in Maryland’s 6th Congressional District.
[**Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution to help boost my campaign’s momentum and WIN BACK Maryland’s 6th Congressional District!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=a66f2ea489&e=0a12281e0e)
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=3dda77293a&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress because I was raised by a single mom in Puerto Rico who always showed me how hard work and determination is what makes us all live the American dream. I learned english when I was 5 years old, and from that young age always felt so proud to be an American.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=88ccca1a20&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress as a military veteran. I began my journey of service to our nation in 2005 when I joined the U.S. Air Force at the age of 20. During my military service I had the honor of serving my county abroad in the Global War on Terror, serving within the Task Force Medical and the Bagram Theater Internment Facility (BTIF) in Bagram, Afghanistan, during Operation Enduring Freedom in 2007. I know what sacrifice looks like - and this is why I love my country so much.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=1734edcf3b&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for my kids, your kids, and your grandkids. Everything that I do in my life is to make the best possible future for my daughter and my son and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has offered me my entire life.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=31f02377a9&e=0a12281e0e)
[**I’M RUNNING FOR CONGRESS BECAUSE WE HAVE A COUNTRY TO SAVE!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=77e8a6e15b&e=0a12281e0e)
Even during our most challenging moments, we are fortunate to call America our home. But it's clear that under the Biden administration, we face significant challenges, our prospects are dwindling, we are weak on the world stage, our economy is failing, and American families are being left behind every single day.
[**I’m running for Congress because America can do better with leaders that will always fight for America first. No matter what.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=926f9b4814&e=0a12281e0e)
**As a military veteran** , I intimately understand the profound significance of service and the willingness to make the ultimate sacrifice for my country. My time in the military taught me the unwavering commitment to duty, honor, and the defense of freedom. It's a bond that transcends words; a deep-seated connection with the men and women I served alongside, many of whom paid the ultimate price. I've witnessed the selflessness, courage, and dedication that define the character of those who choose to protect their nation.
**As a medical logistician** , my mission was to ensure that our dedicated warfighters had the essential tools and supplies required to save lives on the frontlines. I understood the critical nature of my role in providing our troops with the medical resources and equipment they needed to deliver immediate care in challenging and high-stress situations. I am now prepared to take the knowledge, commitment, and understanding I gained in that role with me to Congress, where I will tirelessly advocate for policies that will support our country, military and American families first. Above anything.
**As a** **mother** , I understand firsthand the deep commitment and love that comes with the responsibility of providing for one's family. In the countless roles we take on as parents - caregiver, protector, educator, and provider - we become intimately acquainted with the challenges and triumphs of family life. We witness the struggles that many families face, whether it's making ends meet, securing access to quality education, or ensuring our children have the healthcare they need. It's in these moments that we are inspired to take action, to advocate for better opportunities, and to fight for a brighter future for our families.
I know how to make our community, district, and America strong and proud because i’ve done it before.
[**And i’ll do it again as your next Congresswoman.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=c318f1c384&e=0a12281e0e)
As your next Congresswoman for Maryland’s 6th Congressional District I will always fight for policies that will revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s out of control spending, champion school choice & parental rights, and save America’s future.
But, in order to do this, I need your support today so I can spread this message to everyone across our district and country.
[**Will you chip in today to help me win this fight for our nation’s future?**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=b0a6bf42a0&e=0a12281e0e)
Together we WILL flip Maryland’s 6th Congressional District for Republicans and make America strong and proud again.
Sincerely,
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=d069575f88&e=0a12281e0e)
Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for CongressMaryland’s 6th District

Fast forward to May 2023 when CallHub decided to make their “values” public. In which they state they only work with Democrat candidates. We didn’t realize this since we have been using this service for a few years and have not had any prior issues with this. CallHub was more than happy to approve our political campaign knowing we were Republican in August 2023. They approved the account as a Republican candidate after their so-called “values” were published. So what has changed now? My thought is that they are monitoring us and now know that we have a real chance at winning this seat and pose a threat to the “liberal” and “progressive” candidates they support. While we are happy that we now know who we were inadvertently doing business with, it now leaves our campaign in a predicament where now 30 days before the election we need to scramble to find another service and get re-certified as a political entity to be able to send these messages and reach voters. This all costs money and takes time away from everything we had planned for the next 30 days. It’s sad that conservative candidates continue to be silenced and censored by companies like this. But we are going to push forward and adapt and overcome like we always do. Please consider helping the campaign out today by donating to our text message fund below so we can get our texting service back and running today without any delay. Donate by clicking below. ⬇️ Postcards and Mailers on the way to voter mailboxes! 💌 | | | | | | | | | | Very excited to announce that our very first batch of postcards and mailers have been sent and are on the way to voters across the 6th district! Our Amazing Team Roca volunteers have been handwriting postcards for the last couple of months and it truly has been a labor of love. We have already been receiving feedback from voters who have already started receiving postcards and they are truly making an impact. We have also sent out our first batch of 10,000 mailers to Republican absentee voters in the district. Absentee ballots have already been mailed by the state of Maryland, and it was crucial that our campaign get these out on time. We still have work to do with sending postcards and mailers. Our goal is to send at least 3K more postcards and 20K mailers to voters. This is one of the parts of the campaign that cost a lot of money to complete. If you would like to help us with our last batch of postcards and mailers, please consider donating to our postcard and mailer fund by clicking below. ⬇️ Upcoming Meet & Greets 🤝🏼 | | | | | | | | | | Our remaining Meet & Greet events for the primary election have been scheduled! We will be meeting at Ledo Pizza in Frederick on April 16th and Bistro 11 & Lounge on April 23rd. These are the last planned events to come meet Mariela and hear what great things the campaign is working on, and how we plan to WIN in 2024. If you are in the area and interested in attending, please visit our events page by clicking below. ⬇️ Fundraising 🙏🏽 With absentee ballots set to be mailed out by the state of Maryland starting on or after March 30th, we are facing a tight deadline to ensure our message reaches every voter in our district. To make this happen, we must raise a minimum of $20,000 by April 20th in order to get our materials out in time. Your contribution today will play a crucial role in funding our outreach efforts, including mailers, text messages, phone calls, and postcards. Here is what our campaign needs help with in the next 30 days to get over the finish line: 1. Postcard Mailing: $3,000 2. Mailer: $8,000 3. Door Hangers: $1,000 4. Texting: $2,000 5. Digital Advertising: $6,000 We understand that these are challenging times, but the future of our district and country is at stake. We need your help now more than ever. Please consider donating today to help us get through the primary election on May 14th here in Maryland. Every dollar you contribute will bring us one step closer to ensuring a Republican victory in November for Maryland 6th, one of the most crucial races in the country that can decide our House Majority! Please click on the link below to make your secure contribution: The future of our Republican majority in the House of Representatives hangs in the balance. We cannot afford to lose sight of the importance of securing seats like Maryland's 6th Congressional District if we want to keep a Republican majority in the House of Representatives. 🇺🇸 Sincerely, Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for Congress MD-06U.S. Air Force Veteran | More about Mariela Roca My name is Mariela Roca. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for Congress here in Maryland’s 6th Congressional District. I’m running for Congress because I was raised by a single mom in Puerto Rico who always showed me how hard work and determination is what makes us all live the American dream. I learned english when I was 5 years old, and from that young age always felt so proud to be an American. I’m running for Congress as a military veteran. I began my journey of service to our nation in 2005 when I joined the U.S. Air Force at the age of 20. During my military service I had the honor of serving my county abroad in the Global War on Terror, serving within the Task Force Medical and the Bagram Theater Internment Facility (BTIF) in Bagram, Afghanistan, during Operation Enduring Freedom in 2007. I know what sacrifice looks like - and this is why I love my country so much. I’m running for my kids, your kids, and your grandkids. Everything that I do in my life is to make the best possible future for my daughter and my son and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has offered me my entire life. Even during our most challenging moments, we are fortunate to call America our home. But it's clear that under the Biden administration, we face significant challenges, our prospects are dwindling, we are weak on the world stage, our economy is failing, and American families are being left behind every single day. As a military veteran , I intimately understand the profound significance of service and the willingness to make the ultimate sacrifice for my country. My time in the military taught me the unwavering commitment to duty, honor, and the defense of freedom. It's a bond that transcends words; a deep-seated connection with the men and women I served alongside, many of whom paid the ultimate price. I've witnessed the selflessness, courage, and dedication that define the character of those who choose to protect their nation. As a medical logistician , my mission was to ensure that our dedicated warfighters had the essential tools and supplies required to save lives on the frontlines. I understood the critical nature of my role in providing our troops with the medical resources and equipment they needed to deliver immediate care in challenging and high-stress situations. I am now prepared to take the knowledge, commitment, and understanding I gained in that role with me to Congress, where I will tirelessly advocate for policies that will support our country, military and American families first. Above anything. As a mother , I understand firsthand the deep commitment and love that comes with the responsibility of providing for one's family. In the countless roles we take on as parents - caregiver, protector, educator, and provider - we become intimately acquainted with the challenges and triumphs of family life. We witness the struggles that many families face, whether it's making ends meet, securing access to quality education, or ensuring our children have the healthcare they need. It's in these moments that we are inspired to take action, to advocate for better opportunities, and to fight for a brighter future for our families. I know how to make our community, district, and America strong and proud because i’ve done it before. As your next Congresswoman for Maryland’s 6th Congressional District I will always fight for policies that will revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s out of control spending, champion school choice & parental rights, and save America’s future. But, in order to do this, I need your support today so I can spread this message to everyone across our district and country. Together we WILL flip Maryland’s 6th Congressional District for Republicans and make America strong and proud again. Sincerely, Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for CongressMaryland’s 6th District | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | | | Copyright (C) 2024 Roca for Congress. All rights reserved.

| | If someone asked me to describe this new law I am proposing, you could reasonably answer: this one is absolutely for the birds. It is called The Migratory Birds of the Americas Conservation Enhancements Act. Here is how it works, why it matters, and why it has received bipartisan support out of committee on its way to the House floor. **There are nearly three billion fewer birds than there were two generations ago. That is billion, with a B.** Three billion anything is an astounding amount. So to say that we have lost that many birds over the last 50 years is worth stopping, taking a moment to think, and then asking: what can we do right now to help. The answer is this law. Across the United States, crisscrossing thousands of miles, migratory birds journey between part-time homes. Along the way are crucial stretches of land, habitats for these birds, in urgent need of rehabilitation. **This bipartisan act would set aside lifeline funding for what is called the Neotropical Migratory Bird Conservation Act program, and would further take down bureaucratic barriers for partner groups to rehabilitate habitats used by bird populations as they make their long journeys across America.** While I know a lot of people can rightly question whether a divided Congress, often fighting over extreme ideas, can focus on issues like these: ones that are important, but do not get body:

#
_Content warning: this email discusses online harassment via digital forgeries of pornography._
Did you see the _Rolling Stone_ article about Alexandria’s newest bill to regulate AI?

Nearly 96% of deepfake images and video created by AI contain pornographic imagery of women — all of which is created non-consensually. Last year, more deepfake abuse videos were shared than every previous year combined.1
So Alexandria worked closely with abuse survivors to write the Disrupt Explicit Forged Images and Non-Consensual Edits (DEFIANCE) Act. If passed, victims could sue anyone who ‘knew or recklessly disregarded’ their consent when they created, shared, or received the deepfake pornography.
Alexandria has been the target of disturbing online harassment for years. But she isn’t afraid to hold those that are causing harm to account.
[Alexandria came to Congress to legislate in a new way: by really centering everyday people and the policies that benefit their lives. body:
Serving the people of our Commonwealth has been my great honor, and I’m running for re-election to continue making progress in the fight for workers’ rights, women’s rights, and voting rights.

| Peter, I wanted to write to you about why I’m running for re-election and why I need your support.

If you don’t need an explanation, you can make a donation to my campaign and Fight for Progress at this link: [_**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/blu-ffp-casey-2024?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-04-10_1 &amount=25**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82759828/466251760/-887798292?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-04-10_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjljOGE2OGY3LTVmZjctZWUxMS1hYWYwLTdjMWU1MjAxNzAzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=EDe9r2qphyJa4EmqxUJ5OPR0tdgSovCx0oomrt0Z_uU=)

Pennsylvania is my home. It’s where I was born, where I grew up, and where Terese and I raised our family.

It’s also where I started a career in public service that has always been about fighting for Pennsylvania families, children, seniors, veterans, and people with disabilities.

Serving the people of our Commonwealth has been my great honor, and I’m running for re-election to continue making progress in the fight for workers’ rights, women’s rights, and voting rights.
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82759836/466251769/-887798292?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-04-10_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjljOGE2OGY3LTVmZjctZWUxMS1hYWYwLTdjMWU1MjAxNzAzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=EDe9r2qphyJa4EmqxUJ5OPR0tdgSovCx0oomrt0Z_uU=)
Since I launched this campaign a year ago, I’ve been traveling across the Commonwealth, from Erie County to Bucks County and everywhere in between, talking with Pennsylvanians about what I’m doing to lower costs for working families, build a stronger economy that works for everyone, and ensure that our seniors have the benefits they've earned.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82759844/466251778/-887798292?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-04-10_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjljOGE2OGY3LTVmZjctZWUxMS1hYWYwLTdjMWU1MjAxNzAzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=EDe9r2qphyJa4EmqxUJ5OPR0tdgSovCx0oomrt0Z_uU=)
But the reality is that my opponent is the wealthiest self-funder running for Senate anywhere in the country. He has already put $2 million of his own personal fortune into this race, and that is just the beginning.

Friend, Today is Eid al-Fitr, which is usually a joyous celebration marking the end of Ramadan. Eid Mubarak to my fellow Muslims in Michigan’s 12th, across our country, and the world. May Allah accept your fasts and deeds of the past month, and forgive us of our shortcomings. I spoke on the House Floor this morning and reminded my colleagues that this Eid is not the same for the Muslim communities they represent. Gaza is on their minds and hearts today as they witness the starvation and ethnic cleansing of Palestinians. The images of children in Gaza celebrating Eid on top of the rubble of their homes, schools, and masjids that no longer stand brings them to tears. I urged my fellow members of Congress to listen to them and to not only offer prayers, but demand a permanent ceasefire. Saving lives should not be controversial. It’s been more than 6 months of U.S.-backed genocide against the Palestinian people. This Eid, we recommit to pushing our government to stop funding and arming Israel’s military, to stop the Israeli government’s forced starvation of millions of Palestinians, and to end apartheid and occupation. **May we recommit to acting each day to honor and respect all human beings, especially people who are treated as less than human.** At the start of Ramadan this year, I lost my Sity, my grandmother Muftieh. I feel like a part of me died too. It brings me to tears knowing that my Sity never saw a Free Palestine. But I know her body and spirit will forever be in Palestine, among her olive trees and fig trees. Even during so much pain and grief over my Sity's passing and the genocide in Gaza, our community is showing me the way forward. I know that we will keep creating a world where Palestinians and all people are allowed to live—and to live with dignity. **This Ramadan, we sent emails fundraising for two organizations doing on-the-ground work to support people in Gaza. Together, we raised over $130,000 for this urgent and life-sustaining aid.** Thank you so much for your ongoing activism and support. I’m honored to be by your side, working together for a better world. clean_body: It’s been more than 6 months of U.S.-backed genocide against the Palestinian people. | | | Friend, Today is Eid al-Fitr, which is usually a joyous celebration marking the end of Ramadan. Eid Mubarak to my fellow Muslims in Michigan’s 12th, across our country, and the world. May Allah accept your fasts and deeds of the past month, and forgive us of our shortcomings. I spoke on the House Floor this morning and reminded my colleagues that this Eid is not the same for the Muslim communities they represent. Gaza is on their minds and hearts today as they witness the starvation and ethnic cleansing of Palestinians. The images of children in Gaza celebrating Eid on top of the rubble of their homes, schools, and masjids that no longer stand brings them to tears. I urged my fellow members of Congress to listen to them and to not only offer prayers, but demand a permanent ceasefire. Saving lives should not be controversial. It’s been more than 6 months of U.S.-backed genocide against the Palestinian people. This Eid, we recommit to pushing our government to stop funding and arming Israel’s military, to stop the Israeli government’s forced starvation of millions of Palestinians, and to end apartheid and occupation. May we recommit to acting each day to honor and respect all human beings, especially people who are treated as less than human. At the start of Ramadan this year, I lost my Sity, my grandmother Muftieh. I feel like a part of me died too. It brings me to tears knowing that my Sity never saw a Free Palestine. But I know her body and spirit will forever be in Palestine, among her olive trees and fig trees. Even during so much pain and grief over my Sity's passing and the genocide in Gaza, our community is showing me the way forward. I know that we will keep creating a world where Palestinians and all people are allowed to live—and to live with dignity. This Ramadan, we sent emails fundraising for two organizations doing on-the-ground work to support people in Gaza. Together, we raised over $130,000 for this urgent and life-sustaining aid. Thank you so much for your ongoing activism and support. I’m honored to be by your side, working together for a better world. Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=2bfa826b73fa46199cf5c3ebe76e53ef&_e=baXjK-tbNCTYPTJlEtGPkVlMp-6M-X8Jp3acM9Fg3lpiA-Aw9mZfyNcDJJAkUsFdBiByTmqvdcwfvnVf9Nusrz1wW017pM0N3lfjseRhIoKwkoMXSSzRpZEc_UyKI371eQ_QGp3AiCgCodyqFBPmDAd7cGYOrmpn5kSh_JQ59yheq7PNzaXHtllHEjWRLTfJnTExMVLMJx5m7kveET7niDO0ZxHi9eRqw2qhLvJ23Is73_-VBc2GPwHGVLIPtZR2V1H9CPnW1yuDNHmoeyJBrA5R1wPEbTc60_1RtKMALJ3LCNl4TQEqAbPiUY3f2DPgjwjlTagoX5IwjGLNCQwPKO7E6Ce8XsXQIZ1e2a_nIA0OKci7hQH9h7uZh6mje8oxo5lXK5XwAtoFiQvWs366ucYB-rlnUJDFCmTTz5z09B4%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=2bfa826b73fa46199cf5c3ebe76e53ef&_e=baXjK-tbNCTYPTJlEtGPkVlMp-6M-X8Jp3acM9Fg3lpiA-Aw9mZfyNcDJJAkUsFdBiByTmqvdcwfvnVf9Nusrz1wW017pM0N3lfjseRhIoKwkoMXSSzRpZEc_UyKI371eQ_QGp3AiCgCodyqFBPmDAd7cGYOrmpn5kSh_JQ59yheq7PNzaXHtllHEjWRLTfJnTExMVLMJx5m7kveET7niDO0ZxHi9eRqw2qhLvJ23Is73_-VBc2GPwHGVLIPtZR2kcPy0VS_zYKS39aoUMzrbYQl2drTeP0UPYKCmLSCAFPK-JdJixWfuJCXlsdSgqmmvcNZws6_apzjkV_xtSJb7SGAGaVs0bosaKpZ2tv-sBl_ruUVQreAQ3ZxLZE_uElZD6K2uxv56CUTdsoxmnfDZqze8VXkO_BgrPqOkhu4zrQ%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.** If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, **[please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=2bfa826b73fa46199cf5c3ebe76e53ef&_e=baXjK-tbNCTYPTJlEtGPkVlMp-6M-X8Jp3acM9Fg3lpiA-Aw9mZfyNcDJJAkUsFddv7uRevlDW7rTuQjQQAsvopooScHhblLoocyGX1ph_lUduuRDup7HunNwfqw0izHhAvfUdLIWj4oITcm2qg32YZKwn-Twv4fzAoASgTvx8u7AxXidq-mWAluH1JzntNWHMRCM1VD1vh-2n63pcHL3zpCtxqpH7qXNBjXmd5slfQLwkHi2y1wt5gmDm0uTw8ItbbsqKMwSoE1sIXQoe_G2fXimDzraU9qUJgfbC5MJWNVjfSfiVhKLgk8yk1Mp1ndjRbohrKone9N90sVHajsCQ3r3pYPhnt5y70bBhBZQax9YpjNnhLikqDK1wbLJs1dtBKdOmwNwEb38ASyyqqI5T3Xg2pXG0TR7xZxieemVWo%3D)** ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes.

We fought in Iraq, _**I was there.**_ We fought in Afghanistan, _**I was there.**_

And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times.

I want to look at my children and tell them, _**“Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.”**_

[](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=2bfa826b73fa46199cf5c3ebe76e53ef&_e=baXjK-tbNCTYPTJlEtGPkVlMp-6M-X8Jp3acM9Fg3lpiA-Aw9mZfyNcDJJAkUsFdBiByTmqvdcwfvnVf9Nusrz1wW017pM0N3lfjseRhIoKwkoMXSSzRpZEc_UyKI371eQ_QGp3AiCgCodyqFBPmDAd7cGYOrmpn5kSh_JQ59yheq7PNzaXHtllHEjWRLTfJnTExMVLMJx5m7kveET7niDO0ZxHi9eRqw2qhLvJ23Is73_-VBc2GPwHGVLIPtZR27gamoYGkSDhQiHRwQ9uVLaMHz6dP8iHyHq0F2Q2CMomHgOvlAuOigjrEnuczH47DZqL_EgfHfQxzdAmVYZG-7UOQ4oDYGWI8Cwot3FgXcr56em6o0n3PPwQtkv61rcX2P5NUY4dCq3NqEIzivH4yjBeQzg401aZMc95m-HcrE5s%3D)
**But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it.**

We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams. Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, those are the traits that define me. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead. This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, “I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’” Every day it got worse. Every day it was a disaster. The adult in the room never materialized. Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport. Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.” I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil. If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right. If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy. It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. Unlike Joe Biden, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield. I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes. We fought in Iraq, I was there. We fought in Afghanistan, I was there. And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times. I want to look at my children and tell them, “Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.” But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it. So, Fellow Conservative \- that’s what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting to restore faith in our American way of life. I entered the political arena to ensure the sacrifices my friends made weren’t made in vain. For America's Future, Tim Sheehy Former Navy SEAL Republican Candidate for U.S. Senate | " "I SERVED AS A NAVY SEAL, BUILT ONE OF THE LARGEST AERIAL FIREFIGHTING COMPANIES IN AMERICA CREATING OVER 200 MONTANA JOBS, AND STARTED A VETERAN-LED CATTLE RANCHING AND FEEDING OPERATION. WHETHER IT WAS IN WAR OR BUSINESS, I SEE PROBLEMS AND SOLVE THEM. AMERICA NEEDS CONSERVATIVE LEADERS WHO LOVE OUR COUNTRY. I'M RUNNING FOR THE U.S. SENATE BECAUSE OUR CAMPAIGN IS ABOUT SERVICE, DUTY, AND COUNTRY -- NOT POLITICS AS USUAL." | | PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA Tim Sheehy is a former Navy SEAL. body:
I'm going to keep fighting back against Joe Biden's disregard for the rule of law. | | | | |
---
Joe Biden visited Wisconsin this week to announce a new student loan repayment plan.
His plan doesn’t forgive students loans. It simply shifts the burden to taxpayers who did not go to college or paid off their own loans.
**I joined Dan O’Donnell to discuss my strong opposition to the Joe Biden’s new policy.**
[Listen to My Interview with Dan O’Donnell Here!](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=289854b873&e=e907534017)
**(1:32:30 - 1:43:45)**
The Biden Administration already tried to pass a student loan repayment plan, but the Supreme Court ruled it unconstitutional.
Now, the President is trying to bypass the Supreme Court and Congress by rolling out another student loan repayment plan.
This is the latest example of the Biden Administration’s disregard for the rule of law.
**Joe Biden’s plan is unconstitutional, unfair, inflationary, and political.**
[Watch My Response to Biden’s New Student Loan Repayment Plan](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=4baef287c0&e=e907534017)
I’m going to keep fighting back against Joe Biden’s disregard for the rule of law.
**But I’m going to need your help.**
National Democrats have labeled me as a top target.
They’ve already spent more than **$2.2 million attacking me on Milwaukee TV.**
If you’re willing and able, **donating to my campaign will help me continue pushing back back against Joe Biden’s disregard for the rule of law**.
[Click Here to Donate to Bryan Steil](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=7c96655fa9&e=e907534017)
Thank you for your continued support.
On Wisconsin,
Bryan Steil

name: Team Cornel West 2024
subject: Dr. Cornel West: Meet Your New Vice President
body:
Independent Presidential Candidate Dr. Cornel West Announces Dr. Melina Abdullah

| | | [ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/r?u=_QNNQW2tAN4twyqSMXtPZZvwqqdGyWWNdWLXNho8-dk&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cw_vp_melina_abdulla&n=1)
---
Dear Peter, **Today we joyfully introduce to you Dr. Cornel West's truly inspired choice for his Vice Presidential running mate in his people-powered independent presidential campaign—the esteemed Dr. Melina Abdullah.** Brother West made this historic announcement this morning on The Tavis Smiley Show, marking a significant milestone in the campaign's commitment to fighting for a society and world based on justice, equality, and the empowerment of poor and working class people of all colors. __
---
[ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?amount=50&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cw_vp_melina_abdulla&n=2)
---
_"At this historic and pivotal moment, it is my profound honor to stand alongside my dear sister, Dr. Melina Abdullah, a fierce and tireless advocate for truth, justice, and transformative change,” Dr. West proudly announced. “Sister Melina’s incredible courage, keen intellect, and deep vision have greatly served the cause of liberation in education, worker rights, and both racial and gender justice. Her unique Black analysis and witness helps us confront our crumbling era of empire, white supremacy, and patriarchy. I look forward to working with her as we strengthen our commitment in our campaign for truth, justice and love!"_
---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?amount=50&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cw_vp_melina_abdulla&n=3 "INDEPENDENTS PROTECT INDEPENDENCE: DONATE NOW") [INDEPENDENTS PROTECT INDEPENDENCE: DONATE NOW](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?amount=50&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cw_vp_melina_abdulla&n=3)
---
Melina Abdullah is a revered Professor of Pan-African Studies at California State University, Los Angeles, and a long-time celebrated community organizer. She is known for her work as a union mobilizer, a founding member of the Black Lives Matter movement and Director of Black Lives Matter Grassroots, and an advocate for systemic change through educational, community, and political organizing. _“I am deeply honored and humbled to join Dr. Cornel West as his Vice Presidential candidate at this critical moment as we work together for transformative change. This campaign offers a real vision for the world that stands in opposition to oppressive forces and holds fast to the universal principles of truth, justice, and love.

As we work arm-in-arm with justice-loving people everywhere, we reimagine and work to build a world that chooses goodwill over greed, courage over cowardice, and liberation over exploitation. Together, we are igniting a movement to not only dismantle harmful systems, but establish the firm foundations of a just, nurturing, and free world."_
---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?amount=50&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cw_vp_melina_abdulla&n=4 "DISMISS THE DUOPOLY - DONATE NOW") [DISMISS THE DUOPOLY - DONATE NOW](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?amount=50&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cw_vp_melina_abdulla&n=4)
---
**Dr. Abdullah’s academic and activist work profoundly aligns particularly with the Cornel West campaign’s Gender, Transformative, Racial, Worker and Education Justice Pillars:**
* **Transformative Justice:** Her leadership in the Black Lives Matter movement and initiatives such as the #PeoplesBudget and #BlackXmas showcase her commitment to policy changes that seek to fundamentally reshape society to uplift those at the margins.

* **Gender Justice:** Abdullah has been a vanguard in advocating for the rights and recognition of women, particularly Black women, within both the academic and broader social ecosystems.

* **Racial Justice:** As a founder of the Black Lives Matter chapter in Los Angeles and an outspoken advocate for police reform and community empowerment, Abdullah's work has been pivotal in addressing systemic racial inequities.

* **Worker Justice:** With years of experience as a union leader, Abdullah has fought tirelessly for the rights of workers, advocating for fair conditions, equitable pay, and a voice for faculty and staff in the university system.

* **Education Justice:** Her efforts were instrumental in making Ethnic Studies a requirement in the Los Angeles Unified School District and the California State University system, ensuring future generations understand the diverse histories and contributions of all peoples.

---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?amount=50&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cw_vp_melina_abdulla&n=5 "CHOOSE TRUTH, JUSTICE & LOVE - DONATE NOW") [CHOOSE TRUTH, JUSTICE & LOVE - DONATE NOW](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?amount=50&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cw_vp_melina_abdulla&n=5)
---
**The Cornel West campaign invites all to join the growing groundswell of radical, people-powered change galvanizing a nation growing weary of equally destructive false “choices.”** With this announcement, the campaign is currently pursuing an aggressive 50-state strategy to gain independent ballot access for every voter in the upcoming presidential election, encouraging every citizen to value their vote and dismantle the corporate-backed duopoly.
---
**Please gather the courage to stand with us in this urgent moment and help us build a more just and equitable future for all.** In service and solidarity, **Team Cornel West for President 2024
[CornelWest2024.com](CornelWest2024.com)**

body:
If Kari Lake was so adamant about her support for abortion bans in 2022, why would anyone trust her now that she’s changed her tune?
#

Back in 2022, Kari Lake had this to say about the near-total abortion ban in Arizona:
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-apr24.p6MMmT&refcode=em240410-1-120&t=1&akid=2192%2E734936%2E-_A0JW)
She had a lot to say about abortion bans back then. She called abortion the “ultimate sin” and was pushing to enforce this extreme ban during her last campaign.
But at some point over the last year or so, she realized that restricting the rights that generations of women were born with is incredibly unpopular, and that this near-total ban on abortion from a law originally passed 160 years ago could hurt her chances at gaining more power and influence.
So... she’s running from her past statements as fast as she possibly can. There’s a word for that: Gaslighting.
If Kari Lake was so adamant about her support for abortion bans in 2022, why would anyone trust her now that she’s changed her tune?
We won’t let Arizona forget that Kari Lake strongly supported this law, and that her hero Donald Trump made these abortion bans possible when he filled the Supreme Court with far-right justices.
What is absolutely crystal clear is that we have to defeat Kari Lake and send Ruben Gallego to the U.S. Senate.

subject: Every day it got worse
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA
body:
When I saw everything that we’d worked for in Afghanistan washed away in a matter of days, I decided to consider serving in government once again | [](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=16de3042867442708f84824c2241c500&_e=zhe6h0A0oFHVID1ZuQ89uZIS3NZzGr-oHp8KgL6kSn88EUZUcxnJz7-XPlfFhmkq5Ygijl2DkSfaB4Lwu7XKTiYEWklgfqEbqfn2nx9eF8-KUSXluqkXenEAxCk-wR8HJ7mZTCmnDKv2vSNa-pa3sma8OeAyuF-eX1QEZsexjS3Dk6lKL3gfxS4H2ioDTMzDvLErC5c6h0GtKMqf5uQPUFNdkmdC7fUUo0uE9SLO2zeKjzT8MQWNb2RmPU6sZuP826yu0bc5V9u0Wm4cE-AmfOKYs_RubulRXDiPlYn7qI4kviiXlOl-CRi62aoGeNKcCS5PDfICMBtMeaTOQXEZKCSNdOJf8gfkn5gQDKVAEFtnCc-tieG7d0U9WeteXUqn-XyUMI6EUlbFaB1pLUPT_lw9nsOSVa7Pmu6F7IcUTKs%3D)

---
Peter,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=16de3042867442708f84824c2241c500&_e=zhe6h0A0oFHVID1ZuQ89uZIS3NZzGr-oHp8KgL6kSn88EUZUcxnJz7-XPlfFhmkq5Ygijl2DkSfaB4Lwu7XKTiYEWklgfqEbqfn2nx9eF8-KUSXluqkXenEAxCk-wR8HJ7mZTCmnDKv2vSNa-pa3sma8OeAyuF-eX1QEZsexjS3Dk6lKL3gfxS4H2ioDTMzDvLErC5c6h0GtKMqf5uQPUFNdkmdC7fUUo0uE9SLO2zeKjzT8MQWNb2RmPU6sZuP826yu0bc5V9u0Wm4cE-AmfF2HAWOuPf3HpOrGt_PBJIGJu5cpIRgYVYMhbNHAEKBINvbLI2_Fn0j7i8yjtZ29W_JtDe0cTQeOukiTfypMogbeqdux9sceznlxcAwuELUi5k7ZnOWlp3nyPVkFuqeWNOT43YN6VhKHw7uzGMopnUQ%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=16de3042867442708f84824c2241c500&_e=zhe6h0A0oFHVID1ZuQ89uZIS3NZzGr-oHp8KgL6kSn88EUZUcxnJz7-XPlfFhmkq5Ygijl2DkSfaB4Lwu7XKTiYEWklgfqEbqfn2nx9eF8-KUSXluqkXenEAxCk-wR8HJ7mZTCmnDKv2vSNa-pa3sma8OeAyuF-eX1QEZsexjS3Dk6lKL3gfxS4H2ioDTMzDvLErC5c6h0GtKMqf5uQPUFNdkmdC7fUUo0uE9SLO2zeKjzT8MQWNb2RmPU6sZuP826yu0bc5V9u0Wm4cE-AmfMTmxdZjwR7XnBZT4_Oi5MsyCZLQx8Jj-m-hcBmr1qLWs1Tu6HvJ02KgGXoDjjQtbosQ2NrCtyPf8s2psBsVEdgbBucO8nHAGHVT57atQ66RptYbOxLPLR_zO0B54GwtgZCGLfFu3TX7-_MM7A5H-94%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

_**FIRST:**_ Young voters made history by showing up in record numbers to the polls in 2020. Their determination to not sit idly by while our democracy was facing a major threat likely changed the outcome of the election.
**_BUT THEN:_** Far-right politicians across the nation responded by introducing hundreds of new voter suppression provisions specifically targeting young voters. Texas’ extreme abortion ban continues to force women to carry dangerous, nonviable pregnancies that could kill them. **And this week, Donald Trump officially endorsed these extreme abortion bans across the country.**

I wanted you to hear the news from me: I’m officially running for re-election to represent the Massachusetts 7th District.
When I first ran for Congress in 2018, some folks cynically said nothing would change. That a Democrat is a Democrat. That I had nothing to offer and that our movement was fleeting. But starting with Election Night in 2018, we’ve proved the pundits wrong — we have made history together. “What has changed” they ask? Everything.

.

in

This is the kind of change we can make when the people closest to the pain are closest to the power, driving and informing policy-making. We CAN continue to build a future where working one job is enough, bodily autonomy is a human right, homeownership is within reach, and policies are rooted in humanity and love — but only if we keep fighting.
So, Peter, I’m asking you to invest in this fight by splitting a contribution of $25 or anything you can to support my re-election campaign and MassDems . Vicente Gonzalez, a life-long Democrat, is a candidate for Texas’ 34th U.S. Congressional District.
From humble beginnings, Vicente was raised in a military family. Through hard work and pure ganas, Vicente aimed to make something of himself. His mother stressed to him over and over again that education was the key that will open doors of opportunities. Vicente made the decision to get his life back on track by going back to school to get his GED, working and attending classes at community college, and earning his college degree alongside other military families at the Embry Riddle Aeronautical University on the Corpus Christi Naval Air Station. Vicente surpassed his and his parents' dreams when he graduated from Texas A&M School of Law, earning his Juris Doctorate degree.

While in law school, Vicente learned how government should work. Through his experience as a Congressional Intern in Washington, D.C., Vicente learned how government really works. After law school, Vicente didn’t stop learning, and continued his training in Negotiation at Harvard University School of Law.
Vicente started his business, the Law Offices of V. Gonzalez and Associates, in McAllen and married Lorena Saenz, a former teacher and administrator in Edinburg and McAllen schools. Vicente has focused his practice on fighting for a level playing field for working families wronged by corporations and insurance companies evading responsibility. Through several victories for our community, Vicente recovered millions in tax dollars for South Texas school districts after shady contractors misspent millions in bond money and put our children in physical danger.
Today, Vicente Gonzalez is fighting for our South Texas values in Congress as a member of the Committees on Financial Services and Foreign Affairs and the Select Committee on Economic Disparity and Fairness in Growth. Vicente has stood by our promise to veterans, helping constituents cut through red tape at the VA and working across the aisle to prevent the shameful deportation of our honorably discharged veterans. He’s working to lower prescription drug prices, protect the benefits and healthcare of seniors, and ensure that jobs and opportunities are there for all with the ganas to work.

name: Wesley Bell
subject: I’m proud to come from a union family.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BELL FOR MISSOURI
body:
I know firsthand the crucial role unions play for workers and the working class. Peter — I am proud to come from a union family.

I know firsthand the crucial role unions play for workers and the working class, _that’s why I’m honored to be endorsed by six labor unions in St. Louis._

Building a stronger economy starts with fortifying workers' rights and ensuring equity for working Americans. As a former union member (NEA), I understand the importance of standing shoulder-to-shoulder with workers.

In 1967, my grandfather, Reverend Melvin T. Bell, fearlessly spearheaded a strike against Duncan Foundry and Machine Works in Alton, Ill. His leadership resulted in significant improvements in pay and benefits for workers, culminating in a landmark ruling by the National Labor Relations Board.

Fast forward to 2018, amidst the fight against "right-to-work" laws, I took to the streets, knocking on doors to rally support to defeat Proposition A. Together, we stood firm urging voters to say "NO" to measures that threatened workers' rights and fair labor practices. **In Washington, D.C., I will continue to be a strong advocate for workers' rights and a voice that amplifies the need for fair wages and equitable treatment.**

President Joe Biden is making strides at providing good-paying jobs across the nation, and I am committed to advancing these initiatives rather than hindering them. But if I’m going to cross the finish line this November, I’m going to need the support of this grassroots team.
