As a former union member (NEA), I understand the importance of standing shoulder-to-shoulder with workers. In 1967, my grandfather, Reverend Melvin T. Bell, fearlessly spearheaded a strike against Duncan Foundry and Machine Works in Alton, Ill. His leadership resulted in significant improvements in pay and benefits for workers, culminating in a landmark ruling by the National Labor Relations Board. Fast forward to 2018, amidst the fight against "right-to-work" laws, I took to the streets, knocking on doors to rally support to defeat Proposition A. Together, we stood firm urging voters to say "NO" to measures that threatened workers' rights and fair labor practices. body:
Yesterday, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.
Team, I am incredibly disappointed.
Yesterday, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.
They are enforcing a near-total ban on abortion that was originally passed before Arizona was even a state, in 1864, during the Civil War.
**No exceptions for rape. No exceptions for incest.**
As a father, I am fearful for my daughter. As an Arizonan, I am fearful for the people of my state. And as an American, I am absolutely furious that this has come to pass.
It’s not lost on me that this happened because of the Supreme Court that Donald Trump built, and because the Senate failed to act to protect abortion rights when they had the chance.
It’s a dark day, but this is **NOT** over.
If I make it to the Senate I will do everything I can to pass legislation that will make the protections provided by _Roe v. Wade_ the law of the land — including reforming the filibuster if that’s what it takes.

Peter,

Years ago, our country promised hard-working Americans that if they worked hard and paid into Social Security and Medicare, it would be there for Americans when they needed it most.

For decades, that has been true, and hard-working Americans have retired with dignity and security because of Social Security and Medicare. However, with Republicans controlling the House, these earned benefits are now at risk even as Republicans continue to tell the American people that's not what they plan to do. **Well, actions speak louder than words.**

In their latest move, the Republican Study Committee (RSC) — a caucus representing **80% of House Republicans** — **made it clear that robbing Americans of their earned benefits is at the top of their list** when they renewed a call to cut Social Security benefits and raise the age of retirement.

**Breaking our promise to hard-working Americans isn't right.** That's why Kim is fighting back against these attacks on Social Security in Congress on behalf of WA-08, but she needs to know you have her back.

body:
Here’s who I’m supporting
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38820%2E3422442%2EzlhLmf)
Derek, today I’m excited to announce Truth to Power’s first official endorsements of the 2024 election cycle.
Dave Min, Derek Tran, and Will Rollins are California Democrats running in key House districts. All three are rejecting corporate PAC money, so anything you give makes a real difference. **[Can you make a donation right now that will be split between these three campaigns and Truth to Power?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em20240410-endorsements?refcode=em20240410-38820&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38820_3422442_zlhLmf&akid=38820%2E3422442%2EzlhLmf)**
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em20240410-endorsements?refcode=em20240410-38820&refcode2=38820_3422442_zlhLmf&akid=38820%2E3422442%2EzlhLmf)
**Dave Min** is running in CA-47, the Orange County district I currently represent in Congress. I gave up this seat when I ran for the U.S. Senate, and I have confidence this seat will continue to be represented by a progressive Democrat for years to come. But winning in this district takes real work and serious resources, which is why Dave could use your support to defeat the same MAGA extremist opponent this team helped me defeat in 2022.
**Derek Tran** is running in CA-45, another Orange County district—this one represented by a Republican. Derek is an Army veteran, workers' rights attorney, City Commissioner, father of three young kids, and son of refugees. With enough grassroots support, we can flip this district back to blue and help deliver a Democratic majority.
**Will Rollins** is running in CA-41, a district that includes Palm Springs. As a former federal prosecutor who focused on counterterrorism and counterintelligence, he helped prosecute some of the insurrectionists who attacked the Capitol on January 6th. | As you read this email, voters across the district are already casting their vote for who they want to represent MD-2 in Congress.

Mail-in ballots have been distributed, which means that the primary election is officially underway— _**and we can't take a single vote for granted!**_

As Baltimore County Executive, we’ve led a bold and transformative vision for Baltimore County and built a more open and connected government that is responsive and delivers real results for our communities.

Peter,
Our organization does a lot of work on electing young leaders who are dedicated to making progress on issues plaguing the lives of young people all across the country like gun reform, access to healthcare, and the list goes on. A lot of these issues are not situations we have created, but all of them are issues that affect us.
**There is one such issue that we will have no choice but to solve sooner rather than later: Climate Responsibility.**
This month is Earth month, and it’s an especially blaring reminder that we must lead on this issue for the surroundings we enjoy around us. It is about the air we breathe, the water we drink, and the produce we eat. These policies will dictate if we have nature around us for those moments when we laugh and dance in an open field or look up to the stars for inspiration. The decisions we make now will impact memories to come for generations that aren’t even here yet.
Our country’s lack of climate responsibility is something that we ought to solve as soon as possible. As clichéd as it sounds, we really only have one Earth and are going to be living here well past any politician who is failing us on climate policy now.
**[So Peter, we hope you will join us in calling for swift and decisive actions to protect our Earth through policies that double down on the positive Climate Responsibility we all share.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/signup/lwd_20240410_climate/?source=em20240410-545&akid=545%2E587540%2Eo727rR)**

Peter,
Yesterday, the Arizona Supreme Court ruled that a near-total abortion ban from 1864 is enforceable.
For some perspective, here’s what was going on in 1864:

was
not
a
state

Slavery
was
still
legal
*
Women
could
not
vote
or
own
property
This territorial law is horrifying. It attacks our most basic rights, doesn’t include exceptions for rape or incest, and criminalizes doctors and anyone else who helps a woman get an abortion.
It has been on the books for 160 years, but after Roe v. Wade , it became unenforceable. For decades, women and girls in Arizona were protected from this archaic law. That ended with Dobbs — a Supreme Court decision Kirsten’s opponent, Juan Ciscomani, “applauded.”
Ciscomani is now trying to distance himself from these extreme restrictions on reproductive rights. But he paved the way for these attacks, celebrated the end of Roe , and voted to restrict abortion access across the country.
Republican lawmakers can’t avoid their responsibility for this.
Kirsten is unapologetically pro-choice. She is proud to be endorsed by Planned Parenthood, EMILY’s List, and Reproductive Freedom for All. She’s the voice we need fighting for our fundamental rights in Congress.

clean_body: [] Peter, Yesterday, the Arizona Supreme Court ruled that a near-total abortion ban from 1864 is enforceable. For some perspective, here’s what was going on in 1864: Arizona was not a state Slavery was still legal * Women could not vote or own property This territorial law is horrifying. It attacks our most basic rights, doesn’t include exceptions for rape or incest, and criminalizes doctors and anyone else who helps a woman get an abortion. It has been on the books for 160 years, but after Roe v. Wade , it became unenforceable. For decades, women and girls in Arizona were protected from this archaic law. That ended with Dobbs — a Supreme Court decision Kirsten’s opponent, Juan Ciscomani, “applauded.” Ciscomani is now trying to distance himself from these extreme restrictions on reproductive rights. But he paved the way for these attacks, celebrated the end of Roe , and voted to restrict abortion access across the country. Republican lawmakers can’t avoid their responsibility for this. Kirsten is unapologetically pro-choice. She is proud to be endorsed by Planned Parenthood, EMILY’s List, and Reproductive Freedom for All. She’s the voice we need fighting for our fundamental rights in Congress. This is one of the most flippable seats in the country. Will you help Kirsten turn AZ-06 blue and fight for our reproductive rights by chipping in now? name: Hill Harper
subject: Making sure you didn’t miss your chance, Peter
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY HILL HARPER FOR MICHIGAN
body:
We cannot let the Supreme Court further erode reproductive freedom.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1149%2E62735%2EKEG9bA)
Hi, Peter —
I’m forwarding my email from last week because I wanted to make sure you didn’t miss your chance to **[sign on in support of mifepristone — a safe and effective drug used in medication abortions that is at the heart of an outrageous Supreme Court case right now.](https://act.hillharper.com/survey/em_HHR_PET_MifepristoneSCOTUS_040324/?source=em_HHR_PET_FWD_Mifepristone_041024&t=2&akid=1149%2E62735%2EKEG9bA)**
You can read my original email below to get a better picture of what’s at stake, but the bottom line is this: **Any attempt to roll back reproductive freedom is an attack on women and bodily autonomy, and we _must_ rise up to defeat it.** Otherwise, we risk opening the door to more attacks on our personal freedoms, medication access, and healthcare decisions at the hands of extreme Republicans — something we can _never_ allow.
That’s why we need to speak up, Peter. If you haven’t already, please take a moment to sign on in support of keeping mifepristone legal and accessible for everyone who needs it.
**[SIGN THE PETITION: DEFEND MIFEPRISTONE »](https://act.hillharper.com/survey/em_HHR_PET_MifepristoneSCOTUS_040324/?source=em_HHR_PET_FWD_Mifepristone_041024&t=3&akid=1149%2E62735%2EKEG9bA)**
Thanks for adding your name,
\- Hill

**Begin forwarded message:**
\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Hill Harper [(info@e.hillharper.com)](https://act.hillharper.com/survey/em_HHR_PET_MifepristoneSCOTUS_040324/?source=em_HHR_PET_FWD_Mifepristone_041024&t=4&akid=1149%2E62735%2EKEG9bA)
Date: April 4, 2024
Subject: An important email about the Supreme Court and access to critical medical care. I hope you take a moment to read it.
> Peter, this is a long but important email about access to mifepristone, a drug used in medication abortions.
> Last month, the Supreme Court heard arguments in a completely bogus case that could restrict parts of the FDA’s approval of a critical (and safe) drug, mifepristone, used in medication abortions. **The Supreme Court will soon decide whether to keep mifepristone available or reinstate dangerous restrictions on it.**
> We need to be clear about this: Medication abortions accounted for the majority — 63% — of all abortions last year. _Any_ attempt to ban mifepristone and medication abortion is an attack on women’s reproductive freedom.
> Our legal system is fundamentally broken if a legally and medically unfounded case like this one can make it all the way to the Supreme Court. **We _must_ change the status quo in Washington, and that’s not going to happen until we change who we send to Congress.**
> **[In the Senate, I’ll fight to protect abortion access at the federal level _and_ fix the broken system that got us here in the first place. If you’re with me, please sign our petition in support of mifepristone!](https://act.hillharper.com/survey/em_HHR_PET_MifepristoneSCOTUS_040324/?source=em_HHR_PET_FWD_Mifepristone_041024&t=5&akid=1149%2E62735%2EKEG9bA)**
> **[SIGN ON »](https://act.hillharper.com/survey/em_HHR_PET_MifepristoneSCOTUS_040324/?source=em_HHR_PET_FWD_Mifepristone_041024&t=6&akid=1149%2E62735%2EKEG9bA)**
> Born into a family where stethoscopes & lab coats were symbols of dedication and service, I understand deeply the sanctity of the medical profession. My parents, both esteemed doctors, and my grandparents, who also devoted their lives to medicine, instilled in me an unwavering respect for the noble pursuit of healthcare.
> **Abortion is an integral part of healthcare. It must remain a decision made in the sanctity of a doctor-patient relationship, free from the overreach of government.**
> I will not sit idly by and watch the Supreme Court decide a case that will impose unnecessary roadblocks to the prescription and distribution of a safe drug. I will not sit idly by and watch extremist Republicans put their far-right agenda above the will of the voters. **And I will not sit idly by when the power to build a better future for Michigan and the nation is _entirely within our hands._**
> **[Peter, I hope you’ll join me. Please, sign our campaign’s petition to keep mifepristone safe, legal, and accessible. Our voice is our power.](https://act.hillharper.com/survey/em_HHR_PET_MifepristoneSCOTUS_040324/?source=em_HHR_PET_FWD_Mifepristone_041024&t=7&akid=1149%2E62735%2EKEG9bA)**
> In solidarity,
> Hill Harper
> [](https://act.hillharper.com/survey/em_HHR_PET_MifepristoneSCOTUS_040324/?source=em_HHR_PET_FWD_Mifepristone_041024&t=8&akid=1149%2E62735%2EKEG9bA)
* * *
**[DONATE »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bax_hh_email?refcode=bax_hh_emailfooter&t=9&refcode2=1149_62735_KEG9bA&akid=1149%2E62735%2EKEG9bA)**

I will not sit idly by and watch extremist Republicans put their far-right agenda above the will of the voters. And I will not sit idly by when the power to build a better future for Michigan and the nation is entirely within our hands. In solidarity, Hill Harper

**I put a bullet through Osama bin Laden's skull, Friend. **

It's Rob O'Neill. I'm a Navy SEAL. At my core, I am built to serve this country; I will do _**WHATEVER**_ it takes to make America safe and prosperous.

I hope you share that sentiment. And if you don't, then the rest of this message just isn't for you. Feel free to delete this email and move on with your life if you're not committed to American excellence.

**If you 're still reading, then I thank you for your commitment. And now, I'm counting on you to rise to the occasion, Friend. **

My Navy SEAL brother, Senior Chief Derrick Van Orden, needs your help. He served our nation for over 25 years in the Navy and fought extremists from the Taliban to Al-Qaeda. body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1330%2E135344%2EDRIGdf)

Friends -
This week, the Arizona Supreme Court reinstated an 1864 abortion ban, wiping out nearly all abortion access in the state. Arizona didn’t even become a state until 1912, but women in the state are now living under a 160-year-old ban with no exceptions for rape and incest.
In light of the news out of Arizona, as well as a ruling out of Florida that will allow a 6-week ban to go into effect on May 1, I wanted to write at some length about the Republican assault on reproductive rights and the specific strategy that they employed after they successfully overturned Roe vs. Wade in 2022.
[**When I am done, I hope you'll consider making a donation to my campaign for Senate, because you have the power to make a difference in the outcome of this race.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-apr24.UpsRlZ&refcode=em240410-2-15&t=2&akid=1330%2E135344%2EDRIGdf)
The truth is, Republicans have not stopped attacking anything in the family of reproductive health issues over the past 18 months. I think about these threats in four major categories, and in each area, Republicans are threatening women's freedom to make decisions about their bodies.
Let's review the bidding.
**Number one is continued threats to abortion medication.** Recently, the Supreme Court heard oral arguments on a case that threatens mifepristone, a safe and legal drug that is used in more than 50% of abortions. The ruling is expected to come down this summer, and if the drug is banned, women in all states would have a hard time accessing abortion care due to a shortage of available medication – even in states like Michigan, where voters enshrined access to abortion in their state constitutions. It would be the first time in history we have judges overturning an FDA decision that a drug is safe.
**Number two is threats to safe and legal life-saving care for pregnant women.** In states that have severely restricted abortion, women who are in the midst of a miscarriage, in the early stages of sepsis, are told to wait in the parking lot of the hospital until they become sick enough that doctors are confident they can provide care without fear of breaking state laws. That grisly reality is happening right now in America. What’s more, a handful of states are criminalizing anyone who helps a patient leave the state to access abortion care. There is even a federal bill that would deny women in the military who were assigned to states with abortion bans the time off to go travel to another state to get an abortion.
**Number three is threats to information about abortion and family planning.** In the past year in Congress, I voted against over a dozen bills that were meant to ban certain institutions from talking about abortion as an option. That means threatening federal dollars for organizations like universities if their health clinic on campus counsels young women that abortion is an option among many.
**And number four is threats to family planning, most recently IVF.** You saw the IVF clinics in Alabama that were closed, preventing families who desperately want children from going through IVF — and some of those treatments were canceled mid-cycle. Some of you know how disturbing that is. The Alabama case, or a similar one, could reach the U.S. Supreme Court. The underlying ideology behind the case would threaten not only IVF, but perhaps also the morning-after pill and certain types of contraception.
In Michigan, we made our decision on this. People here voted that we wanted to enshrine Roe into our state Constitution. But these four threats still loom in Michigan and across the country.
And those are some of the stakes in this election. Control of the U.S. Senate is on the line. So we're talking about not just legislation that Republicans might pass, but also the judges they'd vote to confirm.
Big stuff.
Republicans know it too, and that's one of the reasons anti-choice groups will be active in trying to defeat us. But if we're in this together, we can win this race. So I am asking:
[**Can you please use this link to contribute $3 (or more if you can) directly to my campaign for U.S. Senate in Michigan? I would not ask if these donations were not so important to our success.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-apr24.UpsRlZ&refcode=em240410-2-15&t=3&akid=1330%2E135344%2EDRIGdf)

It would be the first time in history we have judges overturning an FDA decision that a drug is safe. Number two is threats to safe and legal life-saving care for pregnant women. In states that have severely restricted abortion, women who are in the midst of a miscarriage, in the early stages of sepsis, are told to wait in the parking lot of the hospital until they become sick enough that doctors are confident they can provide care without fear of breaking state laws. That grisly reality is happening right now in America. What’s more, a handful of states are criminalizing anyone who helps a patient leave the state to access abortion care. There is even a federal bill that would deny women in the military who were assigned to states with abortion bans the time off to go travel to another state to get an abortion. Number three is threats to information about abortion and family planning. In the past year in Congress, I voted against over a dozen bills that were meant to ban certain institutions from talking about abortion as an option. That means threatening federal dollars for organizations like universities if their health clinic on campus counsels young women that abortion is an option among many. And number four is threats to family planning, most recently IVF. You saw the IVF clinics in Alabama that were closed, preventing families who desperately want children from going through IVF — and some of those treatments were canceled mid-cycle. Some of you know how disturbing that is. The Alabama case, or a similar one, could reach the U.S. Supreme Court. The underlying ideology behind the case would threaten not only IVF, but perhaps also the morning-after pill and certain types of contraception. In Michigan, we made our decision on this. People here voted that we wanted to enshrine Roe into our state Constitution. But these four threats still loom in Michigan and across the country. And those are some of the stakes in this election. Control of the U.S. Senate is on the line. So we're talking about not just legislation that Republicans might pass, but also the judges they'd vote to confirm. Big stuff. Republicans know it too, and that's one of the reasons anti-choice groups will be active in trying to defeat us. But if we're in this together, we can win this race. Trust me, it's a big deal.

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82792844/466301193/2105508926?refcode=ea.3f46d878-82f7-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&ms=ea.3f46d878-82f7-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjNmNDZkODc4LTgyZjctZWUxMS1hYWYwLTdjMWU1MjAxNzAzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=BSQJBFH3OsGctVhEseHm80IrhevbFvBVvoVhM53kcxs=) Today I want to talk about something deeply personal to me: the undeniable link between climate change and health. You probably know me as a climate activist; otherwise, you wouldn't be here. But did you know I'm also a cancer survivor? Two years ago, I battled low-grade B-cell non-Hodgkin's lymphoma — a journey that brought me face-to-face with the stark realities of health and environmental crises. During my chemotherapy, part of me hoped my hair would fall out. I had plans for the new real estate on my head — I was going to tattoo “CLIMATE EMERGENCY” on one side and “WAKE UP” on the other. But this brings me to a question: Why isn't the entire cancer community — hospitals, research centers, and survivors — up in arms about what fossil fuels are doing to us? Not just to our families and friends, but to our planet and our future? I’m sure you are aware that burning fossil fuels is primarily what’s driving the climate crisis. But the climate crisis itself threatens the health of billions of people worldwide. Not only through extreme weather events, fires, and floods that claim lives but also via emerging viruses from ecosystem destruction and diseases carried by vectors like mosquitoes and ticks — which are expanding their territories due to warmer climates. I recently read that the World Health Organization predicts the climate crisis will cause an additional quarter of a million deaths annually between 2030 and 2050 from malnutrition, malaria, diarrhea, and heat stress alone. Moreover, climate change displaces tens of millions of people every year, overwhelming our already stressed health systems. The link between our environment and human health has never been more apparent or more urgent. Yet, there's hope. With the right tools and global cooperation, we can mitigate the health impacts of climate change. Local initiatives are making a difference, proving that collective action can lead to significant change. **This is the core of the Jane Fonda Climate PAC's mission: not just to fight the climate crisis, but to protect our future and our health by challenging the fossil fuel industry and electing leaders who will lead the way to a clean energy future.** **[Your support is crucial in this fight. If you're moved to act today, please consider donating any amount to Jane PAC. This will empower us to elect climate champions dedicated to prioritizing our health and our planet over corporate profits.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82792845/466301194/2105508926?refcode=ea.3f46d878-82f7-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&ms=ea.3f46d878-82f7-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjNmNDZkODc4LTgyZjctZWUxMS1hYWYwLTdjMWU1MjAxNzAzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=BSQJBFH3OsGctVhEseHm80IrhevbFvBVvoVhM53kcxs=)** Together, we can face these challenges head-on and work towards a healthier, more sustainable world for all. subject: We cannot afford to be complacent
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
When we first started our work on gun violence prevention, talking about gun safety was almost universally considered a political loser.
#

Friends -
When we first started our work on gun violence prevention, talking about gun safety was almost universally considered a political loser.
Washington operatives told candidates they couldn’t campaign on it. Even if they agreed with us—and the majority of Americans who support commonsense measures to save lives—they feared the NRA too much.
It’s easy to look at all we’ve accomplished today and think the tides have fully changed on this issue. But that’s not the reality.
We’ve made tremendous progress, but the toll of our gun violence crisis is still way too high. Every day too many lives are taken by gun violence because there are still too many politicians in the pocket of the gun lobby.
[**The only way that will change is if we keep the pressure on. Together. Please contribute $3 right now to send a clear message that our movement is more powerful than the gun lobby.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-apr24.Y_Rik7&refcode=em240410-1-30&t=1&akid=7929%2E3935704%2E4aXc3T)
Yes, it’s true—our movement has significantly shifted public opinion. We know that gun safety is a winning issue. But the gun lobby doesn’t go down without a fight.
Donald Trump is on the ballot. Extreme MAGA Republicans like Lauren Boebert and Marjorie Taylor Greene are still in Congress. The Supreme Court is still packed with right-wing politicians.
The gun lobby sees this election as their chance to stage a comeback. If they can defeat our candidates, then they believe they can roll back our progress, pass their “guns everywhere” agenda, and lock in power for a decade.
So we cannot afford any complacency. We are preparing the most ambitious campaigns and organizing efforts that we’ve ever done, but we need your help to make sure we have the resources to do it.
So Gabby needs you:
[**Can you please contribute $3 or any amount you can spare to support our work? Your donation will be directly invested in our plans to elect gun safety champions up and down the ballot.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-apr24.Y_Rik7&refcode=em240410-1-30&t=2&akid=7929%2E3935704%2E4aXc3T)

name: Team McBride
subject: 5 months to the Delaware primary!
body:
That’s not a lot of time to make sure Sarah has the resources she needs to win.
#
Did you know today marks just **5 months** until the Delaware primary?! That’s not a lot of time to make sure Sarah has the resources she needs to reach voters and secure the Democratic nomination — and then pivot to the general election immediately after.
We have so much to accomplish in these next 5 months! We need to:
📺 Get Sarah’s message out on TV, radio, and the internet
👨👩👦👦 Keep growing our grassroots movement
📋 Organize to reach as many Delaware voters as possible
🗳️ Make sure they have a plan to get to the polls
**The good news is we have a plan to do all of that and more.** [**And if every supporter reading this pitches in just $5 at this 5 month milestone, Sarah will be well on her way to winning! Can you pitch in $5 now to help?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240410-1?refcode=em20240410-1&amount=5&refcode2=23_21716_pDiBok&akid=23%2E21716%2EpDiBok)
Sarah always says she’s not in this race to make history; she’s in it to make a difference for the people of Delaware. But because, if she wins, she would be the first openly trans member of Congress, there’s every reason to believe **Republican extremists like Marjorie Taylor Greene will come after her.**
We’re ready, and we have a plan to run a winning campaign all the way through November. But it’s going to take a lot of resources to put all of our plans into motion, and we’re counting on your grassroots support to help us do it.
[**So with just 5 months left until the primary, will you pitch in $5 to Sarah’s campaign today and help us keep building the campaign we need to win?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240410-1?refcode=em20240410-1&amount=5&refcode2=23_21716_pDiBok&akid=23%2E21716%2EpDiBok)

Team McBride

body:

---
Derek, **209 days left.** That isn’t a lot of time. As the days count down to this November’s election, we need the help of our grassroots team so we can continue to scale up our organizing, data, technology, and voter protection infrastructure. Our campaign is gaining significant momentum, and with each new ballot access victory, we’re moving closer to a historic win this November!

We kicked off our series of victories in North Carolina, where Team Kennedy's tireless efforts amassed over 23,000 signatures, far exceeding the required amount with a buffer exceeding 60%.

Fellow American,

I’m so incredibly grateful that you chose to open and read this email. Only about 30-40% of people open these emails - and with all the political emails being sent these days, I’m so happy you opened this one.

Unfortunately, in order to stay in touch with conservatives like you, I rely on emails, texts, mail, and phone calls.

**With that said, can you please do me the simple favor of reading this all the way to the end?** If you reach the end and still don’t think you can make a difference, then I want to thank you for your time.

With an average of 35% of supporters opening these messages, only 1% of supporters step up and donate. This makes it difficult for my campaign since I depend on Americans like you receiving this email to help me hit my fundraising goal.

I refuse to rely on Hollywood Elites and Dark Money for fundraising goals. I want our conservative values and fight to be fueled by those who believe in them the most - you and me.

**And you know what?** If everyone who opened this email donated just $1 - _**one singular dollar**_ \- we’d blow all of our goals out of the water.

| [**DONATE $1**](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=2f857421d53b42e88f8d180f25c617f6&_e=JJ53kceoV8tIUbOHp-wKCx5xzn-pzD2D7kDJvDYYtn1lYUkrqFOIo6RRbBMEG_Z4cBAowttPLM4iz8BjhC5-p_gvToTJRyc6Dz5MeM-EkvikvsltzF-PZKv1r225RJ7hqkSM-_m8YV_UKh0N9lm2NbFwpGMuFn5KU9j-4f3ix3WiZuKdD-LG5iFMWmdQfO6vp6NtkOhbWbt5lbRbeTzr51I-DLkQmQ69v5CyYFOgiOakrxFJroKbANcC57pkp7E8ck_bJ5h9woPqyhYstntxm65jREnaZmNbcVWp_5QiZ0RKFcNtAnzWxud51y97TGtyxHvV7xjPNOftOYfD66-RSGyGJZG1ePxLtXF4HRuiqEDWCuW2w26-oGtCSl8ZxnzZ_od0xI3w7NG4G2KT_hPNyA%3D%3D)

---

Growing up, hard-working Americans were able to buy homes and live in good and safe communities. Now, with inflation on the rise, it is becoming harder for Americans who make an honest living to be able to live comfortably and see the American dream come to life.

I want to restore America to a time when Americans could afford homes, groceries, cars, and living expenses. These essential costs are growing beyond what many Americans can afford. No one should have to choose between food and shelter.

**[Democrats rely on Hollywood and New York Elites who are billionaires - I rely on people like you, who can give $1, $3, $9, or even $20 to reach my goals.](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=2f857421d53b42e88f8d180f25c617f6&_e=JJ53kceoV8tIUbOHp-wKCx5xzn-pzD2D7kDJvDYYtn1lYUkrqFOIo6RRbBMEG_Z4cBAowttPLM4iz8BjhC5-p_gvToTJRyc6Dz5MeM-EkvikvsltzF-PZKv1r225RJ7hqkSM-_m8YV_UKh0N9lm2NbFwpGMuFn5KU9j-4f3ix3WiZuKdD-LG5iFMWmdQfO6vuy7tuEtGxkMpP5INVmnoTyJjTxkW36Bcjj1p9c0JE97j_IJRtW46tBI4mEr4BVb5Vy9s4elIfcjYqw1LdcTgn4XmNA9M0sakPWt9cTuuYO8XgKZIFjVhTEBuvVrg9Z4vnM1bbKiKNSCUY3bTcGqUdSPTUE9OvfeHma5cikVzvaYReYBsHomfT1En_OKI5hxlaGsdyZDK3ycDarXGQypJZg%3D%3D)**

**I’m humbly asking if you could go above and beyond and donate the cost of a pack of gum - $1.**

[**CHIP IN THE PRICE OF A PACK OF GUM**](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=2f857421d53b42e88f8d180f25c617f6&_e=JJ53kceoV8tIUbOHp-wKCx5xzn-pzD2D7kDJvDYYtn1lYUkrqFOIo6RRbBMEG_Z4cBAowttPLM4iz8BjhC5-p_gvToTJRyc6Dz5MeM-EkvikvsltzF-PZKv1r225RJ7hqkSM-_m8YV_UKh0N9lm2NbFwpGMuFn5KU9j-4f3ix3WiZuKdD-LG5iFMWmdQfO6vp6NtkOhbWbt5lbRbeTzr51I-DLkQmQ69v5CyYFOgiOZekMvcCzev-JrBXtGfTdXgLXD3JdmUGtikIXWupOFIIM1-PzKHhYOlttQGigf_O7_x4AW8aVm7RlqdOgX2So9MKH0DkuqKqNRCuNGf9aEr9bvI2dngBl1c6jpZYvqfrBV5AXbbfofNXTeZoj1nUQRLi8ehkFWz4wK3Z6XfA3IpsQ%3D%3D)
---

_The Left hopes I give up and stop sending you these emails.

They also hope you stop reading these emails.

It’d be their dream come true if we both gave up on our Conservative values._

_**I won’t give up on you, and I hope you won’t give up on me or our Conservative values.**_ I know most people will ignore this, but I need patriots like you to see what we’re fighting for. If you think you’re better off than you were 4 years ago, then I understand why you don’t want to donate today.

But if you’re like me, and believe we must get America back on track and make the American Dream possible again, please donate whatever you can before midnight.

[**DONATE TODAY**](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=2f857421d53b42e88f8d180f25c617f6&_e=JJ53kceoV8tIUbOHp-wKCx5xzn-pzD2D7kDJvDYYtn1lYUkrqFOIo6RRbBMEG_Z4cBAowttPLM4iz8BjhC5-p_gvToTJRyc6Dz5MeM-EkvikvsltzF-PZKv1r225RJ7hqkSM-_m8YV_UKh0N9lm2NbFwpGMuFn5KU9j-4f3ix3WiZuKdD-LG5iFMWmdQfO6vp6NtkOhbWbt5lbRbeTzr51I-DLkQmQ69v5CyYFOgiOb3E573L52n1uY5EPraQ7WxxvXZxTnHkHUpeglAaPFhA0dY837n5gwTqRg6DXC2VdLzgUBHTHKHtQJ1pAKggHGzjYoZxwT9Nz41DoETGGEfLBqcxs-s6aPgsuACJMaRHjiR4l5mUSzdSVuxzhXiDRRXSXhLyPJ9oX6IxPy2XA-TSA%3D%3D)

Riley_

If you reach the end and still don’t think you can make a difference, then I want to thank you for your time. With an average of 35% of supporters opening these messages, only 1% of supporters step up and donate. This makes it difficult for my campaign since I depend on Americans like you receiving this email to help me hit my fundraising goal. I refuse to rely on Hollywood Elites and Dark Money for fundraising goals. I want our conservative values and fight to be fueled by those who believe in them the most - you and me. And you know what? If everyone who opened this email donated just $1 - one singular dollar \- we’d blow all of our goals out of the water. | Growing up, hard-working Americans were able to buy homes and live in good and safe communities. Now, with inflation on the rise, it is becoming harder for Americans who make an honest living to be able to live comfortably and see the American dream come to life. I want to restore America to a time when Americans could afford homes, groceries, cars, and living expenses. These essential costs are growing beyond what many Americans can afford. No one should have to choose between food and shelter. I’m humbly asking if you could go above and beyond and donate the cost of a pack of gum - $1. The Left hopes I give up and stop sending you these emails. They also hope you stop reading these emails. It’d be their dream come true if we both gave up on our Conservative values. I won’t give up on you, and I hope you won’t give up on me or our Conservative values. I know most people will ignore this, but I need patriots like you to see what we’re fighting for. If you think you’re better off than you were 4 years ago, then I understand why you don’t want to donate today. But if you’re like me, and believe we must get America back on track and make the American Dream possible again, please donate whatever you can before midnight. God Bless, Riley | RILEY MOORE: CONSERVATIVE FOR CONGRESS. Washington is all tied up in putting politics over principle. It’s time to put a stop to it and start putting PRINCIPLES OVER POLITICS - starting with YOU! | Paid for by Moore for West Virginia. Arch A. body:
We produced our newest ad, “Self-Inflicted Wound” after this story broke, and today we went up with a $200,000 digital campaign in Montana.
#
Derek,
Tim Sheehy can’t seem to get his story straight.
He told a National Park Service ranger one story about a bullet wound — that an accidental discharge in a park hit him in the arm.
But on the campaign trail, he’s told audiences that the bullet in his arm is an old war wound.
What’s the truth, Tim?
Sheehy is a Republican running for Senate in Montana against Jon Tester. That’s one of the seats Democrats need to win to hold their majority in the Senate.
We didn’t think this story was getting anywhere near the amount of attention it deserved, especially back home in Montana. So we decided to spread the word ourselves. We produced our newest ad, “Self-Inflicted Wound” after this story broke, and today we went up with a $200,000 digital campaign in Montana.
We’re going to make sure that everyone in Montana knows about Sheehy’s shady story.

name: Gene Karpinski, LCV
subject: DEVELOPING: Congress readies votes to allow dirtier cars, toxic air, and more drilling. This could get really bad.
body:
__YOU can help stop Congress from reversing the progress we 've made. |
---

|
Peter -- Congress is returning to Washington, D.C. and we've received word that MAGA Republicans are preparing a series of votes to weaken car emission standards, allow dirty power plants and factories to pump more pollution into our air, and throw open our public lands for fossil fuel companies to exploit.

**This is going to move quickly -- and we need your help.**

LCV teams are on Capitol Hill right now, meeting with members of Congress and combating an onslaught of misinformation from corporate polluters. We rely on support from environmentalists like you to go toe-to-toe with their army of lobbyists. _So we 're asking:_
[Please renew your LCV membership for just $5 today, Peter. ](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/j9y2f_36~)

Here's the situation: in the past year, the Biden-Harris administration has rolled out a series of executive actions to clean up our air, reduce greenhouse gas emissions, and protect public lands from drilling and other destructive industries.

These actions will make a massive difference in the fight against climate change -- but there's a narrow window of time when members of Congress can try to block President Biden's executive orders through spending prohibitions and a provision in the Congressional Review Act.

Every indication is that these votes are about to come down -- and MAGA lawmakers are lining up to **attempt to reverse virtually every positive environmental action the president has taken. **

_We need to respond -- if environmentalists' voices aren't heard, we could lose these fights_. I know you won't let that happen, which is why we're asking for your support.

[Peter, please don't sit this fight out. Renew your LCV membership for just $5 today](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/j9y2f_36~).

Thank you for your support in this critical moment!

Onward,

Gene Karpinski

Hi Peter,
If you’ve seen me on the campaign trail or read about my story, then you might have heard me talking about how the Somos America March of 2006, which happened today, 18 years ago, changed my life and was a pivotal avenue of engagement in Arizona politics.
At that time, not too dissimilar to now, our state was facing a wave of xenophobia and extreme legislation. Like so many in our community, I was galvanized to do something about this, so I marched with over 200,000 people wearing white t-shirts, chanting, ‘Today we march, tomorrow we vote.’
And we’ve been voting ever since.
If you had told that spunky, rebellious volunteer that nearly 20 years later, she would be running for Congress to continue the fight for our communities, I would have laughed so hard.
I’m forever grateful I attended that march and for the organizers who helped pave the way for the rest of us. Today is the 18th anniversary of that march, and our chant still rings true.
‘Today we march, tomorrow we vote.’
Especially with yesterday’s heinous decision by the Arizona Supreme Court to restore an abortion law from 1864, before women had the right to vote, before Arizona was even a state, and before slavery was illegal. The need for us to organize, march, and VOTE has never been more crucial for our future.
In full gratitude for the organizers and organizations of that march.
Raquel Terán
P.S. This is a picture from that march 18 years ago.

Friend,
On Monday, Donald Trump announced that he believes abortion should be left up to the states.
He’s trying to confuse voters and run away from the role he played in overturning Roe v. Wade and stripping women of their fundamental rights. And if he wins this November, nothing is stopping him from enacting a nationwide abortion ban.
Yesterday, we saw the consequences of overturning Roe and “leaving it to the states.”
The Arizona Supreme Court handed down a decision that reinstates a near-total abortion ban from 1864. This 160-year-old law criminalizes doctors and makes no exceptions for rape or incest — and was passed before Arizona became a state, women had the right to vote, and slavery was illegal!
To put this in perspective: of the seven states that touch Colorado, only one (New Mexico) doesn’t restrict women's reproductive freedom.
This means two things.
One, it’s more important than ever to protect reproductive rights in Colorado for those seeking out-of-state abortions. Unable to get proper reproductive care in their own states, many women will choose to travel to Colorado. We must continue to be a haven for them.
Two, the stakes for electing a pro-choice majority to Congress and codifying reproductive rights in Colorado this November just got higher. The only way to prevent barbaric laws like these from taking effect is to pass nationwide protections for reproductive freedom.
I have been working nonstop to elect pro-choice Democrats and codify Roe v. Wade in Colorado and across the country — but I’ll need your grassroots support to get this done. Can I count on you to donate now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_041024_AZAbortion_act]

subject: A complete ban on abortion in Arizona.

body:
Here’s how Kari Lake described the law back in 2022: “I am incredibly thrilled that we are going to have a great law that’s already on the books.”
#

Team, we wish we were coming to you with better news.
The Arizona Supreme Court reached a decision today that will lead to a complete ban on abortion in our state.
A law was passed in 1864 — during the Civil War, before Arizona was a state, before women could even vote — that completely bans abortion with no exceptions for rape or incest.
The Arizona Supreme Court decided that this 160 year old law is enforceable.
Here’s how Kari Lake described the law back in 2022:
“I am incredibly thrilled that we are going to have a great law that’s already on the books.”
This is a tough time. For a lot of you, it’s a frightening time. But it is also a time for action.
We’re asking you to help us defeat Kari Lake by splitting a donation between our campaign and her Democratic opponent, Ruben Gallego.
Electing pro-choice leaders like Ruben is the way to stop a national ban on abortion, and the way we’ll be able to pass legislation protecting abortion in the future.
[**Please, if you can afford it, split a donation between Ruben Gallego and Mark Kelly to help build the infrastructure we need to win in Arizona.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-rg.wM1wBl&refcode=em240410-1-NOR&t=1&akid=5742%2E6688874%2EWUI-pZ)
